_readme: AI-generated textbook assemblies (scripts/textbook/expand.ts). Each entry is a full ConstructionEntry; tabs maps slugs to Sections.tsx CHING_TOPICS lists.

entries.name: Manufactured Stone Veneer: Corner & Field Units
entries.variant: 2.5 lb expanded lath, 1/2 in scratch coat, polymer mortar, cultured flats
entries.material: 2.5 lb self-furring galvanized diamond lath, Type S polymer mortar, cultured stone flats & 90° corner units

tips.frame: Fasten galvanized lath horizontally with cups pointing up, then apply a 1/2 in scratch coat and comb horizontal grooves.
general: Install 90-degree corner units first, alternating long and short legs up the wall to maintain random coursing.
Butter the entire back of each stone unit with 1/2 in mortar and press firmly with a slight wiggle until squeeze-out occurs.

watchOut: Clean any wet mortar droppings off stone faces immediately using a dry brush; wet sponges will smear and permanently stain concrete stone.
Maintain a 4 in clearance above raw earth or 2 in above paved hardscapes to prevent groundwater wicking.

steps.title: Frame corner mock-up backing
steps.detail: Assemble the sole plates, top plates, studs, and corner nailer backer with 16d nails to form a rigid 90-degree outside corner.

steps.title: Fasten OSB sheathing
steps.detail: Attach 7/16-inch OSB panels over the main wall and return framing faces with screws spaced 150 mm on perimeter edges.

steps.title: Install weather-resistive barrier
steps.detail: Apply two layers of Grade D 60-minute building paper, wrapping the outside corner seamlessly with a minimum 400 mm lap.

steps.title: Fasten diamond mesh lath
steps.detail: Secure 2.5 lb expanded galvanized diamond lath with dimples facing inward, wrapping the outside corner continuously without a vertical seam.

steps.title: Apply and scarify scratch coat
steps.detail: Trowel 1/2-inch Type S polymer-modified mortar firmly into the lath to embed the mesh completely, then score horizontal grooves with a scarifier.

steps.title: Set lower corner and field stones
steps.detail: Butter the back of corner units and flats with polymer mortar, seating Course 1 long-leg front and Course 2 long-leg return for staggered corner joints.

steps.title: Set upper corner and field stones
steps.detail: Alternate the corner unit orientation on Courses 3 and 4, pressing field flats firmly into the setting bed with tight, level mortar joints.

entries.name: Balloon-Framed Gable Tall Wall Assembly
entries.variant: Continuous 2x6 studs (12 to 16 ft), dropped gable rake plate, mid-height solid blocking
entries.material: 2x6 #2 Douglas fir tall studs, 2x6 double plates, 2x6 mid-span fireblocking, 16d common nails

tips.frame: Calculate gable stud lengths off the 6:12 roof slope common difference before cutting beveled top ends.
general: Install continuous horizontal 2x6 fireblocking at 10 ft vertical intervals to comply with code.
Sight stud crowns carefully; position all crowns facing outward toward the exterior sheathing plane.

watchOut: Tall unbraced walls buckle easily during raising; brace wall rigidly to floor slab prior to lifting.
Missing horizontal fireblocking creates a chimney flue effect within tall stud cavities.

steps.title: Anchor Sole Plate to Foundation
steps.desc: Bed the preservative-treated 2x6 bottom plate on sill seal and secure with foundation anchor bolts through standard plate washers.

steps.title: Erect Continuous Balloon Tall Studs
steps.desc: Erect full-length continuous 2x6 studs plumb across the layout, toenailing stud feet to the sole plate with 16d common framing nails.

steps.title: Install Mid-Height Solid Blocking
steps.desc: Fit tight 2x6 solid fireblocking horizontally between studs at mid-span to restrict draft spread and reduce tall-stud buckling length.

steps.title: Fasten Dropped Gable Rake Plates
steps.desc: Cap the pitched stud heads with double dropped 2x6 rake plates set 1-1/2 inches below the roof plane to allow continuous gable overhang outlookers.

entries.name: Barrel Vault Ceiling Arch Framing
entries.variant: Radiused 3/4 in plywood ribs at 16 in O.C., 2x4 continuous strongbacks, drywall nailer strips
entries.material: 3/4 in CDX plywood ribs, SPF 2x4 horizontal strongbacks, 3 in framing nails, structural framing clips

tips.frame: Cut one master plywood arch template using a router and pivot trammel, then trace all duplicate ribs from it.
general: Notch the top flat edge of ribs to receive continuous 2x4 strongbacks that lock spacing and resist twisting.
Hang ribs plumb from existing ceiling joists using vertical 2x4 drops secured with structural screws.

watchOut: Check that the vault spring line is dead level down both sides of the hallway to avoid distorted arch geometry.
Provide solid backing at the intersection where the curved drywall meets the vertical sidewalls.

parts.name: North end arch rib (3/4 in plywood)
South end arch rib (3/4 in plywood)

steps.title: Set springline ledger plates
steps.detail: Lay and anchor the two continuous 2x4 ledger plates parallel at 1500 mm outside-to-outside, checking square across diagonals.

steps.title: Erect gable end arch ribs
steps.detail: Stand the front and rear 3/4 in plywood arch ribs plumb on the ledger plates and tack them temporarily into alignment.

steps.title: Install intermediate arch ribs at 16 in O.C.
steps.detail: Position the five intermediate arch ribs on 397 mm layout marks along the ledgers, toenailing each heel to the plate.

steps.title: Fasten crown and haunch strongbacks
steps.detail: Span continuous 2x4 strongbacks across the rib crowns and haunches, face-nailing through the strongbacks into each plywood rib.

steps.title: Attach drywall nailers and corner framing clips
steps.detail: Secure continuous interior drywall nailer strips along the springline and reinforce end ribs to ledgers using structural steel clips.

entries.name: Cantilevered Bay Window Floor & Outriggers
entries.variant: 2x10 cantilever joists (2 ft projection, 4 ft backspan), 45-degree mitered rim joists, subfloor
entries.material: SPF 2x10 joists, 45-degree mitered rim board, Simpson H1 hurricane ties, 3/4 in T&G subfloor, polyurethane adhesive

tips.frame: Maintain at least a 2:1 structural backspan ratio (4 ft inside support for every 2 ft cantilever projection).
general: Cut 45-degree angled corner outriggers carefully so the exterior rim plates form a crisp, symmetrical bay envelope.
Nail solid blocking directly over the exterior bearing wall plate to prevent joist rollover under outer wall loads.

watchOut: Do not notch or drill cantilever joists within the exterior bearing zone.
Insulate and air-seal the underside cavity of the cantilever prior to closing with exterior soffit panels.

steps.title: Assemble rear rim and central cantilever joists
steps.detail: Lay out the rear rim joist and end rim members on layout lines. Face nail the central continuous 2x10 cantilever joists at 300 mm spacing through the rear rim board.

steps.title: Install flanking cantilever joists and outriggers
steps.detail: Position the corner cantilevers and cut-to-length outrigger joists along the angled wing spans. Secure all joist tails into the backspan frame using 16d common framing nails.

steps.title: Secure cantilever joists with hurricane ties
steps.detail: Attach galvanized hurricane ties to the side of each cantilever joist directly above the structural bearing fulcrum line to resist wind uplift and rotational displacement.

steps.title: Fasten 45-degree mitered rim joists
steps.detail: Fit the front straight rim and both 45-degree mitered wing rim boards around the cantilever projection. End-nail into every joist horn and fasten miter joints securely.

steps.title: Glue and fasten 3/4-inch T&G subfloor
steps.detail: Apply construction adhesive along all joist tops. Lay tongue-and-groove subfloor panels across the backspan and bay cantilever floor, driving structural wood screws along all framing lines.

entries.name: Blindside Bentonite Waterproofing on Lagging
entries.variant: Sodium bentonite geotextile sheet nailed to soldier pile wood lagging
entries.material: Sodium bentonite geotextile membrane, washer-head fasteners, bentonite mastic, termination bar, seam tape

tips.frame: Fill gaps wider than 1/2 in between lagging timbers with rapid-setting grout or spray foam prior to hang.
general: Fasten bentonite sheets vertically with geotextile face outward to receive the future concrete pour.
Overlap vertical and horizontal sheet joints a minimum of 4 inches and nail every 12 inches on seam.

watchOut: Protect installed bentonite from rain exposure prior to backfilling or shotcrete, which triggers early swelling.

steps.title: Erect soldier piles and set timber lagging
steps.desc: Position the steel soldier pile flanges plumb and slot rough-sawn timber lagging boards tightly between the piles to establish a planar shoring wall.

steps.title: Install lower sodium bentonite geotextile sheet
steps.desc: Trowel a continuous bentonite mastic fillet along the footing transition, then hang the lower bentonite geotextile membrane flat against the wood lagging with washer-head fasteners.

steps.title: Lap upper bentonite sheet, tape seam, and mechanically anchor
steps.desc: Hang the upper sheet maintaining a minimum 150 mm shingle lap over the lower course, nail through washer heads along the seam, and seal the bottom edge with seam tape.

steps.title: Anchor termination bar and seal top perimeter
steps.desc: Secure a rigid aluminum termination bar across the upper edge of the bentonite membrane into the lagging, then tool a continuous bead of sealant along the top lip.

entries.name: Bridge Abutment Stem & Waterstop Formwork
entries.variant: Heavy-duty modular panel gang forms, 9 in ribbed PVC waterstop, 3/4 in taper ties
entries.material: Steel-ply modular panels, double 4 in steel channel walers, 9 in ribbed center-bulb PVC waterstop, split wood bulkheads

tips.frame: Build split wooden bulkheads to hold the ribbed waterstop centered exactly halfway across the vertical cold joint.
general: Secure the outer waterstop flanges to rebar using hog rings and tie wire every 12 inches to prevent folding during concrete drop.
Torque heavy-duty taper ties uniformly against steel channel walers to withstand hydrostatic concrete head.

watchOut: Do not puncture the central bulb of the PVC waterstop with framing nails or tie wire, as this destroys waterproof elasticity.
Vibrate concrete thoroughly around ribbed wings without touching the vibrator head directly against the flexible waterstop.

steps.title: Set base shoe plates and left end bulkhead
steps.detail: Anchor the wood sole alignment shoe plates to the concrete footing along surveyed stem chalk lines, then secure the solid left end bulkhead and backer cleat.

steps.title: Erect back gang form panels
steps.detail: Stand the modular steel-ply back wall panels against the sole plate shoe and pin adjacent panel joints together along the form line.

steps.title: Install waterstop and split bulkheads
steps.detail: Position the 9-inch ribbed PVC waterstop centered over the joint line and sandwich its web firmly between the split wood bulkhead halves and external cleats.

steps.title: Erect front gang form panels
steps.detail: Set the front modular steel-ply gang form panels onto the front shoe plate parallel to the back form to define the stem wall cavity.

steps.title: Mount double steel channel walers
steps.detail: Clamp double 4-inch structural channel walers horizontally at upper and lower levels on both forms, leaving space between channels for tie rods.

steps.title: Thread taper ties and lock waler plates
steps.detail: Insert 3/4-inch heavy-duty taper ties through waler slots and form tie sleeves, securing both faces with cast waler plates and wing nuts.

steps.title: Install vertical strongbacks and kickers
steps.detail: Fix vertical steel strongbacks across the channel walers and brace firmly against footing shoe kicker blocks to ensure plumb alignment under pour pressure.

entries.name: Cabinet Maker: 32mm Modular Walk-In Closet System
entries.variant: 3/4 in prefinished maple plywood uprights, 32mm hole pattern, cam-lock shelf fittings, oval hanging rod
entries.material: 3/4 in UV-coated maple plywood, PVC edgebanding, Confirmat screws, zinc Rafix cam housings, chrome oval closet poles

tips.frame: Level and anchor continuous horizontal French suspension cleats into wall studs to establish system datum.
general: Drill parallel 5mm shelf pin holes at 32mm intervals using a commercial line boring jig before carcass assembly.
Install at least two fixed structural shelves with mechanical cam fittings per bay to eliminate lateral racking.

watchOut: Ensure hanging cleat fasteners achieve at least 1-1/2 in embedment into solid framing studs to resist wardrobe shear loads.
Check cabinet upright squareness across opposing diagonals before locking fixed cam-shelf fasteners.

steps.title: Stand uprights and set toe-kick plinths
steps.detail: Stand the outer panels and center partition upright on the layout lines. Fasten the recessed toe-kick plinths between uprights using pocket screws.

steps.title: Install bottom and top fixed structural shelves
steps.detail: Seat the bottom and top fixed shelves onto pre-inserted Rafix connecting bolts. Turn the zinc cam housings 180 degrees with a screwdriver to lock the box rigid and square.

steps.title: Secure upper suspension cleats to wall framing
steps.detail: Fit the rear hanging cleats tight under the top shelf and drive structural screws through the cleats directly into wall studs.

steps.title: Lock mid-height structural division shelves
steps.detail: Position the center fixed shelves at system height and lock the cam housings to prevent upright deflection across the double bays.

steps.title: Mount oval wardrobe hanging rods
steps.detail: Screw chrome end-flange brackets into system line-bore holes 70mm below the fixed shelves, then drop the cut-to-length oval rods into place.

steps.title: Insert shelf supports and place adjustable shelves
steps.detail: Push 5mm spoon shelf pins into the System 32 line-bore pattern at designated heights and lay the edgebanded adjustable shelves onto the pins.

entries.name: California Blind Valley Roof Framing with Sleeper Plate
entries.variant: 2x6 flat valley sleeper base, 2x6 valley jack rafters (16 in O.C.) with compound plumb/bevel cuts, ridge connection
entries.material: #2 SPF 2x6 dimensional lumber, 2x8 valley ridge, 1/2 in CDX roof sheathing, 16d common nails, 10d hanger nails

tips.frame: Snap chalk lines on the sheathed main roof plane representing the valley centerline and the outer edge of the flat 2x6 sleeper.
general: Bevel the lower bottom face of the valley sleeper plate so it lays flat against the primary roof slope without rocking.
Cut jack rafters with a compound angle: a plumb cut matching the roof pitch and a 45-degree side cheek cut to sit along the valley line.
Fasten valley jack rafter tails through the sleeper plate directly into underlying main roof framing members.

watchOut: Ensure fasteners penetrate through the sheathing into structural rafters beneath, not just the unsupported plywood deck.
Keep rafters crown-up to prevent dips along the newly framed intersecting roof plane.

parts.name: Main roof deck 1/2 in CDX panel left
Main roof deck 1/2 in CDX panel right

steps.title: Erect the main roof substructure
steps.detail: Stand the four corner 4x4 support posts and secure the 4x6 front and rear header beams flush across the post tops.

steps.title: Set the main sloped rafters
steps.detail: Install the five 2x6 common rafters at 6:12 pitch spanning the header beams on 16 in centers, birds-mouthed and toenail-anchored.

steps.title: Sheathe the continuous main roof deck
steps.detail: Fasten 1/2 in CDX plywood decking across the main rafters to form the solid continuous deck required beneath the blind valley overlay.

steps.title: Erect king post and intersecting valley ridge
steps.detail: Plumb the front gable king post on the front beam and mount the horizontal 2x8 valley ridge board running back to meet the sheathed main slope.

steps.title: Fasten the 2x6 flat valley sleeper plates
steps.detail: Lay the 2x6 valley sleepers flat directly on the sheathing along the true 45-degree valley lines, securing through decking into underlying rafters.

steps.title: Cut and frame the valley jack rafters
steps.detail: Install paired 2x6 valley jack rafters with compound side-bevel foot cuts seated onto the sleepers and plumb cuts nailed against the ridge.

entries.name: Cantilevered Balcony Floor Framing with Outriggers
entries.variant: 2x10 treated joists, 2:1 interior backspan, double rim joist, solid bridging, hurricane ties
entries.material: 2x10 pressure-treated #2 SYP joists, 3/4 in exterior subfloor, Simpson H10A ties, 16d hot-dip galvanized nails

tips.frame: Establish the 2:1 rule: every foot of exterior cantilever requires two feet of continuous interior run.
general: Install solid blocking directly over the exterior bearing wall to eliminate joist rollover under balcony live load.
Crown all cantilever joists upward to counteract balcony deflection after deck finish installation.

watchOut: Never notch the top or bottom edges of cantilevered joists beyond the bearing wall support line.
Ensure proper joist flashing and drainage plane integration where the balcony penetrations exit the exterior envelope.

steps.title: Establish Bearing Wall Support Plates
steps.detail: Lay down double 2x6 treated top plates at the interior tail support and the exterior fulcrum line. Level and secure plates to wall framing below.

steps.title: Position Cantilever and Outrigger Joists
steps.detail: Place 2x10 treated joists spaced at 400 mm on centre across the exterior fulcrum plate, establishing the required 2400 mm interior backspan for the 1200 mm cantilever projection.

steps.title: Nail Interior and Double Cantilever Rim Joists
steps.detail: Face-nail the interior rim joist to back joist ends with three 16d nails per bay. Nail the inner and outer double rim joist across the cantilever tip to resist lateral rotation.

steps.title: Install Simpson H10A Hurricane Ties at Fulcrum
steps.detail: Secure Simpson H10A seismic hurricane ties at every joist on the exterior bearing wall top plate using 1-1/2 in galvanized connector nails to counteract uplift and rotation.

steps.title: Install Full-Depth Solid Blocking and Bridging
steps.detail: Install 2x10 solid wood bridging tight between joists directly over the exterior fulcrum wall line and at interior backspan mid-span to transfer shear and prevent joist rollover.

steps.title: Fasten 3/4-in Exterior Subfloor Diaphragm
steps.detail: Lay 3/4-in tongue-and-groove exterior subfloor panels with face grain perpendicular to joists. Fasten with 8d ring-shank nails at 150 mm edge and 300 mm field spacing.

entries.name: Cathodic Protection: Zinc Anode & Cadweld Bond
entries.variant: 30 lb packaged zinc anode, exothermic weld connection, and test box
entries.material: Zinc sacrificial anode in bentonite bag, #6 AWG copper cable, exothermic weld mold and powder, test station

tips.frame: Soak the packaged anode in clean water for 15 minutes before lowering it into backfill trench.
general: Clean pipeline steel down to bare white metal before clamping the graphite exothermic weld mold.
Ignite weld powder, allow slag to cool, and cover the bonded copper connection with a coal-tar mastic cap.

watchOut: Wear heat-resistant face shields and welding gloves during exothermic powder ignition.

parts.name: 30 lb Packaged Zinc Anode with Bentonite Backfill
1-1/4 In Rigid Test Station Conduit Riser

steps.title: Establish Trench Bed and Place Coated Pipeline
steps.detail: Lay the compacted sand bedding along the trench floor and lower the coated steel pipeline section into position.

steps.title: Place Packaged Zinc Sacrificial Anode
steps.detail: Position the bentonite-packaged zinc anode parallel to the pipeline in native backfill bedding.

steps.title: Execute Cadweld Exothermic Connection & Apply Coating Patch
steps.detail: Remove pipe coating, ignite exothermic weld charge to fuse the copper lead to bare steel, and seal with a mastic patch cap.

steps.title: Erect Conduit Riser and Route Cathodic Cables
steps.detail: Erect the rigid riser conduit, secure the coupling adapter, and pull both anode and pipe lead cables through the shaft.

steps.title: Mount Test Station Head, Shunt, and Terminals
steps.detail: Thread the test station head onto the riser coupling and wire the lead cables across the calibrated test shunt and brass binding posts.

entries.name: Wall Cavity & Soffit Fireblock Framing
entries.variant: 2x4 horizontal blocking at 10 ft vertical intervals, ceiling drop intersection blocks, firestop sealant
entries.material: SPF 2x4 blocking stock, 5/8 in Type X gypsum scrap, intumescent firestop caulk, 3 in framing nails

tips.frame: Measure each stud cavity individually to cut fireblocks snug without spreading or bowing wall studs.
general: Stagger fireblock elevations slightly (1-1/2 in) across bays to permit straight end-nailing through stud faces.
Seal all perimeter edges and service penetrations around blocks with approved red intumescent fire caulk.

watchOut: Leaving gaps wider than 1/8 in around fireblocking voids building code compartmentation compliance.
Install draftstopping at all concealed connections between vertical stud walls and horizontal floor/ceiling cavities.

steps.title: Frame the primary stud wall
steps.detail: Lay the sole plate, position studs at 16 in (400 mm) on center, and fasten through the double top plates with 3 in framing nails.

steps.title: Install mid-height cavity fireblocks
steps.detail: Fit horizontal 2x4 blocking tightly between studs at mid-height, staggering alternate bays to allow direct face-nailing through stud flanks.

steps.title: Set ceiling drop intersection blocks and ledger
steps.detail: Install full-depth 2x4 blocking aligned with the dropped ceiling height and nail the exterior face soffit ledger to seal vertical draft pathways.

steps.title: Place Type X gypsum firestop caps
steps.detail: Fasten 5/8 in Type X gypsum board scrap flat over the horizontal blocking to provide an approved thermal barrier barrier across cavities.

steps.title: Penetrate sleeve and seal with intumescent firestop
steps.detail: Route the vertical service pipe through the fireblock assembly and apply a continuous annular bead of intumescent sealant at pipe and stud perimeter gaps.

entries.name: Subway Wall Tile & Liquid-Applied Waterproofing
entries.variant: 1/2 in cement backer, roller membrane, 3x6 in tiles, silicone inside corners
entries.material: 1/2 in cement backer board, liquid waterproofing membrane, fiberglass mesh tape, modified thin-set, 3x6 ceramic tile

tips.frame: Apply alkali-resistant mesh tape and thin-set over all board seams, then roller-apply two continuous coats of waterproofing membrane.
general: Comb thin-set with a 1/4 x 1/4 in square-notch trowel in horizontal ridges to prevent wet tile slippage.
Leave a 1/8 in perimeter gap at changes of plane (floor and inside corners) for 100% silicone sealant rather than cement grout.

watchOut: Do not spot-bond ('five-spot') wall tiles; achieve a minimum 80% wet thin-set mortar coverage (95% in wet shower areas).
Verify cured liquid membrane wet-film thickness meets the manufacturer's target (typically 30-40 mils) before setting tile.

parts.name: Back wall 1/2 in cement backer board
Return wall 1/2 in cement backer board
Back wall subway tile lower courses
Back wall subway tile upper courses
Return wall subway tile lower courses
Return wall subway tile upper courses

steps.title: Frame corner walls and backing
steps.detail: Erect the back wall and return wall stud partitions, nailing plates and studs plumb and square with a three-stud corner backing.

steps.title: Fasten 1/2 in cement backer board
steps.detail: Hang the backer board panels flush into the inside corner, leaving a 1/8 in gap at the floor and securing with corrosion-resistant screws every 8 inches.

steps.title: Tape and fill inside corner seam
steps.detail: Embed alkali-resistant fiberglass mesh tape directly into polymer-modified thin-set mortar along the vertical inside corner joint.

steps.title: Roll liquid waterproofing membrane
steps.detail: Apply two continuous coats of liquid waterproofing membrane with a 3/8 in nap roller across all cement board faces and over the cured corner seam.

steps.title: Set 3x6 subway tile in running bond
steps.detail: Comb modified thin-set using a 1/4 in square-notch trowel and install 3x6 ceramic subway tiles with 1/16 in spacers, keeping the inside corner unmortared.

steps.title: Seal inside corner with silicone
steps.detail: Inject a continuous bead of color-matched 100% silicone sealant down the inside corner transition to form a watertight flexible movement joint.

entries.name: Cold-Formed Steel Boxed Header & Jamb Stud Pack
entries.variant: Dual 600S162 studs nested with top/bottom runner tracks, clip angles, and cripple pack
entries.material: 6 in 54-mil structural steel studs, 6 in 54-mil track, 14-ga steel clip angles, #10-16 structural tek screws

tips.frame: Snap layout marks for the 48 in rough opening and plumb king studs before anchoring top and bottom tracks.
general: Assemble boxed header by inserting two 6 in structural studs toe-to-toe inside upper and lower track caps.
Connect the boxed header to built-up jamb studs using rigid 14-gauge clip angles screwed with specified fastener counts.

watchOut: Verify structural screw count into clip angles; missing screws compromise header end-reaction capacity.
Keep cripple stud spacing aligned with wall layout to provide continuous backing for interior gypsum board.

steps.title: Anchor bottom and top runner tracks
steps.desc: Align the 6-inch bottom track along the layout line on the floor slab and secure the matching top track directly overhead plumb to the bottom.

steps.title: Erect boundary and king studs
steps.desc: Seat full-height boundary, field, and king studs plumb within the top and bottom runner tracks. Drive two framing tek screws through each track flange into each stud.

steps.title: Fasten nested jack studs to king studs
steps.desc: Nest the jack studs against the king studs down into the bottom track, clamp tightly web-to-flange, and stitch screw every 300 mm along the jamb height.

steps.title: Assemble and place boxed header
steps.desc: Hoist the pre-assembled dual C-stud and runner boxed header beam onto the top ends of both jack studs, verifying bearing and level across the rough opening.

steps.title: Secure header with 14-gauge clip angles
steps.desc: Install heavy-duty 14-gauge steel clip angles at both jamb interfaces, driving structural tek screws into the header web and adjacent king stud flanges.

steps.title: Install header cripple studs
steps.desc: Insert vertical cripple studs between the top flange of the header box and the overhead runner track at standard module spacing, securing both ends with tek screws.

entries.name: Cold-Formed Steel Bypass Curtainwall with Deflection Clips
entries.variant: 600S162 54-mil structural steel studs, slotted slide bypass clips to floor slab edge, continuous bridging channel
entries.material: 6 in 54-mil structural C-studs, slotted vertical bypass slide clips, concrete screw anchors, 1-1/2 in U-channel, #10 Tek screws

tips.frame: Drop a vertical plumb line or laser down the building slab edge to set uniform clearance behind the bypass studs.
general: Drive self-drilling screws into the exact center of the clip vertical slots to allow full slab deflection without binding.
Pass continuous 1-1/2 in cold-rolled lateral channels through stud punchouts and clip each stud with bridging angle clips.
Check that structural studs run continuously past the floor edge without being cut or spliced at the slab line.

watchOut: Do not overdrive or clamp fasteners tight against the slotted face of the slip clip; sliding movement is mandatory.
Maintain specified edge distance when driving concrete wedge anchors into the post-tensioned or reinforced slab edge.

parts.name: 5/8 in glass-mat exterior sheathing panel left
5/8 in glass-mat exterior sheathing panel right

steps.title: Establish the slab edge benchmark
steps.detail: Inspect the structural concrete slab edge for squareness and mark stud centerlines at 400 mm intervals.

steps.title: Anchor vertical deflection bypass clips
steps.detail: Fasten slotted slide bypass clips to the slab edge face at each layout line using two 1/4 in concrete screw anchors per clip.

steps.title: Place bottom runner and top bypass tracks
steps.detail: Align horizontal tracks parallel to the slab with a 30 mm clear thermal and deflection air gap to the structural edge.

steps.title: Plumb and secure 600S162 studs into deflection slots
steps.detail: Seat structural studs into tracks and drive #10 Tek slide screws centered in vertical clip slots to permit slab deflection without stud loading.

steps.title: Thread continuous cold-rolled lateral bridging channels
steps.detail: Pass 1-1/2 in U-channels through stud web punchouts at 1400 mm maximum intervals and secure with bridging clip angles.

steps.title: Hang exterior glass-mat gypsum sheathing
steps.detail: Screw 5/8 in exterior gypsum panels across the exterior stud face at 200 mm perimeter and 300 mm field centers.

entries.name: Cold-Formed Steel Floor Joist & Web Stiffener System
entries.variant: 800S162 CFS C-joists (16 in O.C.), 800T150 rim track, web stiffeners
entries.material: 8 in 16-ga cold-formed C-joists, 16-ga rim track, 68-mil stud-scrap web stiffeners, #10 self-drilling wafer-head screws

tips.frame: Verify web stiffener lengths fit snugly between joist top and bottom flanges with no more than 1/16-inch vertical gap.
general: Fasten stiffener clips directly to joist webs at all foundation bearing and concentrated load points to prevent web crippling.
Seat C-joists fully into the rim track channel before driving screws through top and bottom track flanges.

watchOut: Unreinforced thin-gauge metal joist webs buckle easily under heavy point loads if stiffeners are omitted.
Verify metal filings and chips are swept clean before installing exterior or subfloor panels to prevent galvanic rust.

steps.title: Set out rim tracks
steps.detail: Lay out front and rear 800T150 rim tracks parallel and square at 1400 mm clear spacing.

steps.title: Slide and screw CFS C-joists
steps.detail: Seat 800S162 joists into rim tracks at 16 in (406 mm) on center, driving two #10 wafer-head screws through each track flange into the joist flanges.

steps.title: Install reaction web stiffeners
steps.detail: Fasten 68-mil stud stiffeners vertically against joist webs at both bearing ends to prevent web crippling under design reactions.

steps.title: Fit mid-span solid blocking
steps.detail: Insert track blocking sections between joist webs along the centerline and screw the end tabs securely to arrest joist rotation.

steps.title: Fasten bottom tension strap
steps.detail: Stretch continuous flat steel strapping along the joist bottom flanges across mid-span and secure with two #10 screws per joist.

entries.name: Cold-Formed Steel Box Header with Clip Angles
entries.variant: 600S162 structural studs (54 mil), 14-ga clip angles, #10 hex screws
entries.material: 6 in 16-ga (54 mil) CFS studs, 6 in runner track, 14-ga stiffened clip angles, #10-16 self-drilling screws

tips.frame: Pre-assemble the boxed header on sawhorses by stitch-screwing two studs web-to-web through track flanges before lifting into place.
general: Attach heavy-duty angle clips to jamb studs using specified screw patterns before seating the box header ends.
Keep stud punchouts vertically aligned for clear electrical conduit and plumbing rough-in.

watchOut: Wear cut-resistant leather gloves; sheared cold-formed steel sheet edges produce severe lacerations.
Do not strip out thin screw heads by running screw guns at excessive RPM with worn bits.

steps.title: Set runner tracks
steps.detail: Snap baseline chalk lines and anchor the bottom and top runner tracks plumb to the structure.

steps.title: Erect jamb and common studs
steps.detail: Slide king studs and intermediate studs into the top and bottom tracks, verifying square and plumb before driving screws through track flanges.

steps.title: Frame window sill and lower cripples
steps.detail: Install lower cripple studs on layout and screw the rough sill track across the opening to provide backing.

steps.title: Prefabricate box header assembly
steps.detail: Assemble the structural box header by screwing two facing 600S162 studs inside top and bottom runner tracks at 300 mm centres.

steps.title: Mount box header with clip angles
steps.detail: Hoist the boxed header between king studs and secure each corner using heavy 14-gauge clip angles and #10-16 self-drilling screws.

steps.title: Install upper cripples to top track
steps.detail: Plumb and screw upper cripple studs between the header top track and wall top runner track to transfer overhead loads.

entries.name: Cold-Formed Steel Head-of-Wall Deflection Track
entries.variant: 3-5/8 in 33-mil CFS studs, slotted 43-mil deep-leg slip track, pan-head screws in slots
entries.material: 350S162-33 C-studs, 350T200-43 slotted slip track, 1/2 in concrete drive pins, #8 wafer-head tek screws

tips.frame: Plumb the bottom track to the top slotted track using an optical laser before stud installation.
general: Cut studs 1/2 in to 3/4 in short of the top track web to provide vertical clearance for concrete deck deflection.
Drive screws centered precisely in the vertical slots without over-torquing so studs slide freely without binding.

watchOut: Do not screw drywall directly to the slotted deflection track; keep drywall screws 1 in below the track flange.
Never install screws into non-slotted top tracks unless specifically designed with floating deflection clips.

1/2 in concrete drive pins (bottom track anchors)

steps.title: Anchor Slotted Slip Track to Overhead Concrete Slab
steps.detail: Align 350T200-43 slotted deep-leg track directly under the slab layout line. Fasten web to the overhead concrete slab with 1/2 in concrete drive pins spaced at 450 mm on center.

steps.title: Fasten Bottom Runner Track to Floor
steps.detail: Plumb down from the overhead track web using a laser level and anchor the 350T125-33 bottom runner track directly to the floor with drive pins at 450 mm on center.

steps.title: Erect Studs with Deflection Clearance Gap
steps.detail: Cut 350S162-33 C-studs 19 mm (3/4 in) short of the overhead track web. Seat each stud into the bottom track and slip the top into the slotted track legs.

steps.title: Drive Deflection Slot and Bottom Runner Fasteners
steps.detail: Fasten stud bases rigidly to bottom runner flanges. At the head of wall, drive #8 wafer-head tek screws through the center of vertical slots into stud flanges; do not overtighten.

steps.title: Install Mineral Wool Safing and Gypsum Board Panel
steps.detail: Friction-fit 4 pcf mineral wool safing tight against the underside of the concrete slab. Hang 5/8 in Type X drywall terminated 13 mm below the slab to maintain the deflection joint.

steps.title: Apply UL Firestop Elastomeric Sealant Band
steps.detail: Gun a continuous 3 mm thick wet film of flexible firestop sealant across the mineral wool joint, overlapping at least 13 mm onto both the concrete deck and the drywall face.

entries.name: Cold-Formed Steel: Flat-Strap X-Braced Shear Wall Assembly
entries.variant: 3-5/8 in 54-mil structural studs, boxed boundary jambs, 2 in coiled flat tension straps, and hold-down brackets
entries.material: 350S162-54 studs & tracks, 54-mil gusset plates, 2 in flat steel strap (16-ga), S/HD10 hold-downs, #10 Tek screws

tips.frame: Plumb and square the CFS panel before fastening diagonal strap ends to prevent built-in wall racking.
general: Pre-tension diagonal flat straps hand-tight with locking pliers before driving specified screw patterns into corner gussets.
Fasten boxed jamb studs with track-to-stud structural screws every 12 inches to resist uplift and buckling loads.

watchOut: Do not splice tension straps mid-span; straps must run continuously from corner gusset to corner gusset.
Verify minimum edge distances on Tek screws at gusset plates to prevent steel tear-out under cyclic loads.

parts.name: Tension Strap BL to TR (2 in 16-ga)
Tension Strap BR to TL (2 in 16-ga)

steps.title: Erect Stud Frame and Boundary Jambs
Install Hold-Down Brackets
Fasten Gusset Plates to Wall Corners
Tension and Anchor X-Brace Flat Straps

entries.name: Fan Coil Unit (FCU) Hydronic Valve Package
entries.variant: 1 in run, 2-way modulating valve, circuit setter, Y-strainer, hoses
entries.material: Braided stainless steel flex hoses, 2-way control valve with 24V actuator, manual balancing valve, Y-strainer with blowdown

tips.frame: Suspend unistrut trapeze from drop-in ceiling anchors using 3/8 in all-thread rods.
general: Orient Y-strainer screen housing facing downward on the supply side ahead of control valve.
Connect circuit setter balancing valve on return run with manufacturer-specified upstream straight pipe.

watchOut: Do not twist stainless flex hoses during tightening; use dual backing wrenches.
Insulate all cold surfaces vapor-tight to prevent condensation drip on ceiling tiles.

parts.name: Supply copper spool with PT port

steps.title: Assemble unistrut support frame
steps.detail: Fasten horizontal strut cross rails to the upright strut channels using 90-degree corner angle brackets and channel spring nuts.

steps.title: Install pipe cushion clamps
steps.detail: Insert channel nuts and mount two-piece unistrut cushion clamps to support the supply and return lines at designated spacing.

steps.title: Assemble supply line valve train
steps.detail: Thread together the isolation ball valve, Y-strainer with blowdown, and copper intermediate spool with pressure/temperature port.

steps.title: Assemble return line valve train
steps.detail: Connect return isolation valve, manual circuit setter, spool, and 2-way modulating control valve with motorized actuator in series.

steps.title: Connect flexible braided hoses
steps.detail: Attach 1-inch braided stainless steel flexible hoses to the supply and return run terminal ends ready for coil connection.

entries.name: ISO Cleanroom Wall Panel & Integrated Vinyl Cove
entries.variant: Aluminum honeycomb wall panel, anodized ceiling track, and coved PVC base
entries.material: uPVC-clad aluminum honeycomb panels, anodized aluminum base channel, aluminum cove former, chemical weld seam

tips.frame: Anchor aluminum base track with countersunk masonry screws coated in continuous silicone bedding.
general: Slide modular wall panels into the ceiling track and lower into the floor track interlock spline.
Form a seamless 3/8-inch radius cove from floor to wall panel using rigid cove fillet and heat-welded vinyl.

watchOut: All joint seams and utility cutouts must be sealed with cleanroom-rated silicone to prevent particulate traps.

parts.name: Left uPVC-clad aluminum honeycomb cleanroom panel
Right uPVC-clad aluminum honeycomb cleanroom panel

steps.title: Anchor floor channel and ceiling receiver track
steps.detail: Laser-align and mechanically fasten the anodized aluminum base channel to the finished concrete slab, then secure the matching head track to the overhead suspension grid directly plumb above.

steps.title: Install left cleanroom honeycomb wall panel
steps.detail: Slide the uPVC-faced panel into the top receiver track, lower it into the base channel, and plumb vertically against the grid line.

steps.title: Insert alignment spline and set adjacent panel
steps.detail: Press the structural alignment spline into the panel edge slot, then slide the right honeycomb panel into place leaving a uniform 2 mm expansion and seal margin.

steps.title: Weld flush vertical panel seams
steps.detail: Clean joint rebates and inject sterile cleanroom joint compound on both interior faces, tooling dead flush with the uPVC skin to eliminate particulate ledges.

steps.title: Affix cove former fillets at base junction
steps.detail: Bond 38 mm radius rigid aluminum cove former fillets tight into the 90-degree intersection between the floor slab and panel faces on both room sides.

steps.title: Flash continuous vinyl flooring up wall
steps.detail: Heat-form homogeneous PVC sheet over the cove former fillets and roll 120 mm vertically up the panel faces with contact adhesive.

steps.title: Secure feather-edge cove capping trims
steps.detail: Install anodized aluminum capping strips over the cut edges of the coved vinyl, locking the top boundary and forming a flush hygienic seal to the uPVC face.

entries.name: Cross-Laminated Timber (CLT) Floor-to-Wall Joint
entries.variant: 5-ply CLT wall and slab panels, Simpson AB angle brackets, acoustic resilient inter-layer strip
entries.material: 5-ply spruce CLT panels (140 mm), 3 mm EPDM acoustic profile, 90 mm steel connection brackets, structural timber screws (8x100 mm)

tips.frame: Snap chalk lines on the CLT floor deck matching panel joint drawings before crane placement.
general: Roll out and tack the resilient EPDM acoustic barrier continuously along the wall footprint to decouple vibration.
Drive self-tapping timber screws at perpendicular angles using high-torque cordless impact drivers.

watchOut: Never notch or cut penetrations into the factory-machined CLT bearing edge without timber engineer approval.
Protect CLT edge splines from moisture intrusion and standing water on the deck during erection.

steps.title: Erect and Brace Lower CLT Wall Panel
steps.desc: Position the 140 mm 5-ply spruce CLT wall panel on the layout line. Verify plumb with a spirit level and temporary diagonal raking props.

steps.title: Install Lower Acoustic Resilient Inter-Layer Strip
steps.desc: Roll out and center the 140 mm wide by 8 mm thick EPDM acoustic decoupling strip directly onto the top edge of the lower CLT wall panel.

steps.title: Land and Align CLT Floor Slab Panel
steps.desc: Crane the 140 mm 5-ply floor slab into place over the acoustic strip. Align the rear edge flush with the wall exterior face and check the 140 mm bearing depth.

steps.title: Anchor Floor Slab Underside with Simpson AB Brackets
steps.desc: Place three Simpson ABR90 angle brackets at 550 mm centers against the wall-slab re-entrant angle. Drive 8x100 mm structural timber screws through both flanges.

steps.title: Place Upper Acoustic Strip and Erect Upper CLT Wall
steps.desc: Lay the upper 8 mm EPDM resilient profile over the floor slab along the wall line, then crane the upper 5-ply CLT wall panel into position and plumb.

steps.title: Fasten Upper Wall Interior Angle Brackets
steps.desc: Position three Simpson ABR90 brackets in the interior corner between the upper wall face and floor slab. Fasten completely with 8x100 mm structural screws.

steps.title: Seal Exterior Joint with Airtightness Membrane
steps.desc: Apply high-performance airtight sealing tape across the exterior slab edge, bridging smoothly from the lower wall panel to the upper wall face.

entries.name: Reinforced CMU Bond Beam with Cleanout Ports
entries.variant: 8x8x16 U-blocks, continuous dual #5 rebar on plastic chairs, vertical bar dowels, and 3000 PSI grout
entries.material: 8x8x16 U-shaped CMU bond beam blocks, Type S mortar, #5 Grade 60 rebar, plastic rebar chairs, 3000 PSI coarse grout

tips.frame: Knock out webs of bond beam blocks cleanly to create an uninterrupted horizontal grout trough along the course.
general: Support horizontal rebar on plastic chairs to provide minimum 1 in grout encapsulation around steel.
Tie horizontal reinforcement to vertical wall dowels at intersections with 16-gauge tie wire.

watchOut: Mortar droppings inside the bond beam trough must be cleared before grouting to prevent void pockets.
Consolidate grout thoroughly using a mechanical pencil vibrator without dislodging block alignment.

parts.name: Course 1 CMU block with cleanout port
Course 1 CMU block with cleanout port
3000 PSI coarse grout in vertical cell 1
3000 PSI coarse grout in vertical cell 2
3000 PSI coarse grout in bond beam trough

steps.title: Lay Course 1 blocks and position vertical dowels
steps.detail: Lay the first course of standard CMU blocks on a full mortar bed, including cleanout-faced blocks at grouted core locations. Center the vertical #5 rebar dowels in the open cleanout cells.

steps.title: Lay Course 2 stretcher blocks in running bond
steps.detail: Lay the second course with half blocks on both ends to create a standard half-lap running bond. Verify vertical alignment of the grouted cores with a mason level.

steps.title: Install bond beam U-blocks on Course 3
steps.detail: Lay the 8x8x16 U-shaped bond beam blocks along the third course over a standard 10 mm bed joint. Ensure knockout webs are depressed to allow continuous rebar and grout clearance.

steps.title: Set rebar chairs and dual continuous horizontal bars
steps.detail: Snap plastic rebar chairs onto the trough floor every 800 mm to maintain 38 mm bottom clearance. Lay two continuous #5 Grade 60 bars across the chairs and wire-tie to the vertical dowels.

steps.title: Inspect cleanout ports and secure temporary covers
steps.detail: Inspect cleanout openings to remove mortar droppings and ensure the cells are clear to the base. Fasten temporary plywood cleanout covers over both face shell ports to resist grout pressure.

steps.title: Pour and consolidate 3000 PSI coarse grout
steps.detail: Place 3000 PSI coarse grout into the vertical cells and full bond beam trough in lifts. Consolidate with a mechanical pencil vibrator to eliminate voids around the rebar.

entries.name: Roof Collar Ties & Ridge Metal Strapping
entries.variant: 2x6 rafters (16 in O.C.), 2x8 ridge, 2x4 collar ties in upper third
entries.material: 2x6 rafters, 2x8 ridge board, 2x4 SPF lumber, 18-ga Simpson HRS12 strap ties, 10d sinkers

tips.frame: Snap a horizontal chalkline across all rafter pairs within the upper third of roof height to align collar ties uniformly.
general: Collar ties resist wind uplift and ridge separation; face-nail each end with at least three 10d common nails.
Bend heavy ridge tension straps neatly over the ridge line and nail into opposing rafter pairs.

watchOut: Do not confuse collar ties with ceiling joists; collar ties in the upper third cannot prevent wall spread alone.
Never remove temporary ceiling propping until both sides of rafter collar ties are securely spiked.

steps.title: Anchor double top plates
steps.detail: Lay the lower and upper top plates along both bearing lines, face-nailing the pairs together and verifying parallel span.

steps.title: Set ridge board and center rafter pair
steps.detail: Elevate the 2x8 ridge board on temporary shores and nail the center pair of 2x6 rafters plumb against the ridge face.

steps.title: Frame remaining rafter pairs at 16 inches O.C.
steps.detail: Install front and rear opposing rafter pairs at 16 inches on-centre, seating birdsmouth cuts flat across the top plates.

steps.title: Fasten 2x4 collar ties in upper third
steps.detail: Level and face-nail 2x4 collar ties in the upper third of attic span, securing each rafter lap with four 10d sinkers.

steps.title: Install HRS12 strap ties across ridge
steps.detail: Center 18-gauge Simpson HRS12 straps over the ridge board and nail into opposing rafter top edges to resist uplift separation.

entries.name: Commercial FRP Cladding: Panels & PVC Division Mouldings
entries.variant: 0.090 in Class A FRP sheets, polyurethane adhesive, PVC H-bars, inside/outside corners
entries.material: 4x8 ft embossed FRP sheet, PVC H-dividers, inside/outside corner profiles, FRP adhesive, color-matched silicone

tips.frame: Verify drywall backing is clean, flat within 1/8 in per 8 ft, and pre-cut pipe penetrations oversized by 1/4 in for expansion.
general: Comb polymer adhesive over 100% of panel back with a 3/16 x 5/32 in V-notch trowel to prevent blisters.
Leave a minimum 1/8 in expansion gap inside division tracks and around all perimeter base and ceiling trims.
Roll the installed panel immediately from center outward using a 3-wheel laminate roller to seat the adhesive bond.

watchOut: Omitting thermal expansion clearance at joints and floor will cause heavy panel buckling and popping.
Wear respiratory and eye protection when cutting FRP sheets; fiberglass dust causes severe dermal and lung irritation.
Ensure adhesive open time is not exceeded before pressing sheet to wall to avoid bond failure.

steps.title: Frame the backing wall
steps.detail: Assemble the sole plate, top plate, and seven 2x4 studs on 16 in centers with two 16d nails per connection.

steps.title: Hang moisture-resistant substrate
steps.detail: Fasten 1/2 in greenboard panels flat against the studs with drywall screws spaced 12 in along framing.

steps.title: Install base trim, inside corner, and center H-bar
steps.detail: Plumb and staple the left inside corner profile, level the bottom base cove channel, and align the center PVC H-divider.

steps.title: Adhere the left FRP panel
steps.detail: Trowel polyurethane adhesive with a 1/8 in V-notch trowel, slip panel into corner and division channels leaving 1/8 in expansion, and roll flat.

steps.title: Hang right FRP panel and outside corner
steps.detail: Spread adhesive, seat the right panel into the H-bar web, slip the PVC outside corner trim over the free edge, and roll with laminate roller.

steps.title: Cap top edge and finish with sealant
steps.detail: Seat the top J-cap over the panel tops and inject color-matched silicone sealant along all trim channels and seams.

entries.name: Commercial Vinyl Wallcovering: Double-Cut Butt Seams
entries.variant: Type II 20 oz Osnaburg-backed vinyl, clay primer/adhesive, overlap splice
entries.material: Type II 54 in vinyl wallcovering, heavy-duty clay-based adhesive, wallcovering acrylic primer, fresh razor blades

tips.frame: Plumb a vertical chalk reference line one roll width minus 1/2 in away from the starting corner.
general: Hang adjacent drops with a 2 in overlap, checking pattern alignment across the seam.
Perform a double-cut through both vinyl layers using a straightedge and fresh razor blade, then remove both outer and inner scrap strips.

watchOut: Change razor blades after every double-cut; a dull blade tears the Osnaburg fabric backing and frays the visible joint.
Do not stretch vinyl horizontally with sweepers; stretched vinyl will shrink during adhesive cure and expose gaps.

parts.name: Type X gypsum drywall board 5/8 in
Left vinyl sheet Type II Osnaburg backing
Right vinyl sheet overlapping seam zone

steps.title: Erect stud wall frame
steps.detail: Nail sole and top plates to the layout marks and fasten studs at 600 mm on center using two 16d nails per connection.

steps.title: Hang drywall substrate panel
steps.detail: Fasten 5/8-inch Type X drywall sheet across framing studs with Type W bugle-head screws spaced 300 mm on center.

steps.title: Prime wall with acrylic primer-sealer
steps.detail: Roll a uniform coat of pigmented acrylic wallcovering primer to protect drywall paper against future stripping damage and promote adhesive grab.

steps.title: Spread clay adhesive and hang left vinyl drop
steps.detail: Roll heavy-duty clay-based adhesive evenly across the substrate and position the first Osnaburg-backed sheet plumb, smoothing with a sweep.

steps.title: Hang overlapping right vinyl sheet

steps.title: Double-cut seam and remove salvage strip

entries.name: Compressed Air Drop & Modular FRL Station
entries.variant: 3/4 in copper loop drop, manual drain, modular Filter-Regulator-Lubricator
entries.material: Type L copper tubing, brass ball valves, 3-stage modular FRL unit, quick-connect coupler, pneumatic pressure gauge

general: Take air drop off the top of the main overhead distribution header using a gooseneck bend.
Extend the drop leg 6 inches past the FRL takeoff with a ball valve to create a moisture purge.

watchOut: Never use standard PVC or CPVC pipe for compressed air; shattered pipe fragments become shrapnel.
Depressurize and lock out system before servicing FRL polycarbonate filter bowls.

parts.name: 3/4 in Type L copper drop riser
3/4 in copper drip leg / dirt pocket
Manual drip leg brass drain valve

steps.title: Mount backer board and strut channels
steps.detail: Fasten the 3/4-inch plywood backer panel to wall framing and secure the three horizontal Unistrut channels at plumb spacing.

steps.title: Install copper drop riser, branch tee, and drip leg
steps.detail: Set the 3/4-inch copper drop pipe and bottom moisture-accumulation dirt pocket using cushion strut clamps on the unistrut rails.

steps.title: Install manual moisture drain valve
steps.detail: Thread and seal the brass ball valve and drain spout onto the bottom of the dirt leg for manual condensate purging.

steps.title: Install branch isolation valve and inlet adapter
steps.detail: Thread the main branch nipple, brass shutoff ball valve, and FRL transition nipple horizontally from the drop tee.

steps.title: Assemble and mount modular FRL station
steps.detail: Lock the particulate filter, pressure regulator with gauge, and lubricator into modular joiner brackets and mount to the centre strut.

steps.title: Install outlet shutoff and quick-connect coupler
steps.detail: Thread the secondary isolation valve and pneumatic quick-disconnect female coupler onto the lubricator discharge port.

entries.name: Concrete Column Plyform Box with Steel Wedge Clamps
entries.variant: 3/4 in HDO plyform box (18x18 in ID), 2x4 vertical battens, adjustable wedge-lock steel column clamps spaced progressively
entries.material: 3/4 in High Density Overlay (HDO) plywood, 2x4 kiln-dried lumber battens, steel scissor column clamps with wedges, form release oil

tips.frame: Nail a solid 2x4 timber kicker collar securely to concrete slab anchor pins to prevent form displacement at the base.
general: Space steel column clamps closer together at the bottom of the column form where liquid concrete head pressure is highest.
Stagger overlapping plywood side joints and run vertical 2x4 corner battens to prevent wet paste leakage and blowouts.
Leave a removable cleanout door at the column base to sweep out debris before securing the final bottom clamp.

watchOut: Inspect clamp wedges to verify full mechanical bite; loose wedges will yield under internal concrete vibrator action.
Ensure form release agent does not coat internal rebar or dowels projecting from the foundation.

steps.title: Set out and anchor the base kicker collar
steps.detail: Snap column centre lines on the slab and fasten four 2x4 kicker cleats around the perimeter to lock form base alignment.

steps.title: Erect East and West plyform side panels
steps.detail: Stand the opposing 3/4-in HDO plywood panels inside the kicker cleats, checking for plumb and applying form release agent.

steps.title: Close the form with North and South panels
steps.detail: Lap the North and South HDO closure panels over the side panel edges and tack them square to complete the 18x18-in core.

steps.title: Fasten vertical 2x4 stiffening battens
steps.detail: Screw pairs of vertical 2x4 battens flat against each plywood face to resist bowing and provide positive backing for the steel clamps.

steps.title: Install lower high-pressure column clamps
steps.detail: Slip interlocking scissor clamp arms around the base at 200 mm and 500 mm elevations, driving hardened wedges tight to resist peak hydrostatic head.

steps.title: Install mid and upper clamps at progressive spacing
steps.detail: Place the remaining steel clamps at 900 mm, 1450 mm, and 2100 mm elevations, hammer all corner wedges home, and verify form plumb before the pour.

entries.name: Highway Concrete Paving Dowel Basket Assembly
entries.variant: 12 ft lane width basket, 1-1/4 in x 18 in epoxy dowels at 12 in O.C., expansion caps
entries.material: Collapsible wire dowel basket frame, #10 epoxy-coated smooth dowels, plastic expansion caps, U-shaped steel ground pins

tips.frame: Center dowel basket directly over the marked transverse contraction joint line perpendicular to the roadway centerline.
general: Coat the free sliding end of each smooth dowel bar with specified bond-breaker grease or factory plastic sleeve.
Anchor basket feet to compacted subbase with heavy U-stakes at 2 ft centers to resist concrete slipform paver displacement.

watchOut: Cut temporary factory shipping spacer wires on the top frame before pour so individual dowels can translate freely under thermal cycling.
Maintain dowels parallel within 1/4 inch across all axes; skewed dowels lock joints and cause uncontrolled mid-slab cracking.

parts.name: Base cross tie wire far left
Base cross tie wire far right

steps.title: Position wire basket cages on grade
steps.detail: Align the front and rear wire frame cages across the 12 ft lane width along the marked transverse joint line.

steps.title: Install transverse spacer ties
steps.detail: Snap the cross tie wires into the skid loops to lock the basket assembly to its specified 160 mm base width.

steps.title: Drive ground anchor pins
steps.detail: Drive steel U-pins firmly over the base runner wires into the treated subbase to prevent basket movement during concrete extrusion.

steps.title: Set epoxy-coated dowel bars
steps.detail: Seat the 1-1/4 in by 18 in epoxy dowel bars into each upper frame cradle at 12 in on-center, ensuring true parallel alignment.

steps.title: Install plastic expansion caps
steps.detail: Fit non-metallic expansion sleeve caps over the free greased ends of each dowel bar to permit thermal joint movement.

entries.name: Dragon Beam 45-Degree Corner Joist Cantilever Assembly
entries.variant: 4x8 diagonal dragon beam, 4x6 diagonal tail tie, 2x8 cantilever outriggers, heavy structural corner post
entries.material: #1 Douglas fir 4x8 beam, 4x6 diagonal tie, 2x8 floor joists, 6x6 timber post, structural timber screws, joist hangers

tips.frame: Snap 45-degree layout lines from the exterior plate corner back to the interior anchor tie joist to establish the dragon beam centerline.
general: Notch the dragon beam over the corner post cap to create solid downward bearing while transferring the uplift cantilever load.
Tie the back heel of the diagonal dragon beam down to the perpendicular structural floor joist using Simpson tension straps.
Install perpendicular 2x8 outrigger joists into the sides of the dragon beam using skewed, heavy-duty face-mount hangers.

watchOut: The inward backspan must maintain at least a 2:1 ratio relative to the exterior corner projection to prevent leverage uplift.
Verify the corner column directly beneath the fulcrum point has adequate bearing load transfer to the foundation.

steps.title: Erect timber corner post and cap
steps.detail: Plumb the 6x6 structural post over layout lines and secure the bearing cap.

steps.title: Set perpendicular wall plate beams
steps.detail: Position 4x8 framing beams at 90 degrees meeting directly over the corner post cap.

steps.title: Install diagonal tail tie beam
steps.detail: Set the 4x6 tail tie at 45 degrees between wall plates to anchor the dragon beam heel.

steps.title: Seat 45-degree dragon beam
steps.detail: Bed the 4x8 dragon beam across the diagonal tie and cantilever out over the post corner.

steps.title: Frame cantilever floor outriggers
steps.detail: Fasten 2x8 cantilever floor outriggers into both flanks of the dragon beam.

steps.title: Cap cantilever with corner rim joists
steps.detail: Square and face-nail the exterior 2x8 cantilever perimeter rim boards to close the framed corner.

entries.name: Cripple Wall Framing with Seismic Shear Blocking
entries.variant: 2x4 studs at 16 in O.C. (under 4 ft), 1/2 in CDX sheathing, A35 clips
entries.material: Treated 2x4 mudsill, 2x4 studs, 1/2 in CDX plywood, 5/8 in anchor bolts with 3x3 in bearing plates, A35 clips

tips.frame: Level mudsill across low foundation bumps with plastic shims prior to taking exact height measurements for cripple studs.
general: Fasten boundary nailing around full sheet perimeters with 8d common nails spaced 4 inches on center.
Install continuous solid rim blocking between floor joists directly above the cripple top plate.

watchOut: Untreated wall plates in direct contact with masonry or concrete will rot rapidly.
Ensure anchor bolt washers meet current seismic code (minimum 3x3x1/4-inch square plate).

steps.title: Establish concrete foundation stem wall
steps.detail: Inspect foundation curb for level and alignment to receive the wood cripple framing.

steps.title: Anchor treated mudsill to foundation
steps.detail: Seat the treated 2x4 mudsill over sill sealer and secure tightly with 5/8-inch anchor bolts and 3x3-inch bearing plate washers.

steps.title: Erect cripple studs and lower top plate
steps.detail: Toenail 2x4 studs at 16 inches on center into the mudsill and nail the lower top plate across the stud heads.

steps.title: Install seismic shear blocking and upper plate
steps.detail: Fit solid 2x4 blocking flush between studs at mid-height for panel edge fastening, then face-nail the upper top plate.

steps.title: Fasten interior A35 seismic clips
steps.detail: Nail Simpson A35 framing clips at stud-to-top plate intersections on the interior face to resist seismic lateral loads.

steps.title: Fasten CDX structural shear panels
steps.detail: Hang 1/2-inch CDX plywood across the exterior frame and nail perimeter edges at 4 inches on center and field at 12 inches.

entries.name: Cast-in-Place Concrete Curb & Gutter Forms
entries.variant: 6 in x 12 in curb with 24 in gutter pan, steel skeleton forms, division plates (10 ft O.C.)
entries.material: 10-ga steel curb and gutter forms, division plates, 3/4 in round steel form pins, expansion joint filler

tips.frame: Set back form to top-of-curb elevation using stringline offset by 18 inches from road centerline.
general: Lock skeleton division plates securely into back and front rails to maintain cross-sectional profile during pour.
Strip face form as soon as concrete holds its shape to strike the batter and finish the curb face radius.

watchOut: Drive form pins into firm subgrade below aggregate base to avoid outward form blowouts under foot pressure.
Ensure division plates are lubricated with form release oil to prevent chipping edges upon vertical extraction.

steps.title: Set and pin the back curb form
steps.detail: Align the 12-inch back form to line and grade, driving 3/4-inch round steel form pins into the subgrade along the rear pin pockets.

steps.title: Set and pin the front gutter form
steps.detail: Position the 6-inch front gutter pan form parallel to the back form at a 24-inch gutter spread, securing it with steel pins driven plumb.

steps.title: Insert division plates and expansion joint
steps.detail: Slide profiled steel division plates into the keyed slots at the section ends, and place preformed expansion joint material at mid-run.

steps.title: Hang and clamp the curb face form
steps.detail: Mount the suspended 6-inch battered face form to the division plate notches, locking skeleton top clamps over the curb throat.

entries.name: Curved Radius Partition Wall Stud Assembly
entries.variant: Kerfed 2x4 plates, 2x4 studs at 12 in O.C., 6 ft radius curve
entries.material: 2x4 SPF plates and studs, 1/4 in bending plywood or double 1/2 in drywall backing, construction adhesive, 16d nails

tips.frame: Establish the curve on the floor using a fixed trammel arm from the true centerpoint radius before tacking segmented track plates.
general: Space wall studs closer together (12 inches on center or less) so wall sheathing curves smoothly without faceting.
Plumb down directly from ceiling curved plates using a laser or plumb bob at every third stud location.

watchOut: Deep saw kerfs on curved plates weaken bearing strength; laminate multiple layers of 3/4-inch plywood plates when structural load is present.
Check that screw heads don't bind on angled stud edges during drywall backing application.

steps.title: Lay out and fasten curved sole plates
steps.detail: Snap the 6-foot radius chalk line on the subfloor and secure kerfed 2x4 bottom plate segments along the arc.

steps.title: Plumb and toenail primary radial studs
steps.detail: Erect the end studs, centre apex stud, and intermediate control studs plumb with faces aligned to the radial lines.

steps.title: Set infill studs at 12 inches on centre
steps.detail: Install remaining 2x4 studs between control posts, verifying regular chord spacing across the curved perimeter.

steps.title: Fasten kerfed double top plates
steps.detail: Cap the wall with double kerfed 2x4 top plates bent to the radius and toenail into every stud end.

steps.title: Affix flexible plywood backing skin
steps.detail: Bend 1/4-inch plywood sheathing snugly across the outer convex face with adhesive and screws to lock the wall curve.

entries.name: Deck Ledger Board & Code Flashing System
entries.variant: 2x10 incised PT ledger, 1/2 in hot-dip galvanized thru-bolts, Z-flashing, joist hangers
entries.material: Pressure-treated 2x10 ledger, 1/2 in hot-dip galvanized hex bolts, self-adhering flashing tape, stainless Z-flashing

tips.frame: Set ledger board elevation at least 2 in below the interior floor line to prevent wind-driven rainwater intrusion.
general: Stagger 1/2 in mounting bolts in an alternating high-low zig-zag pattern according to IRC fastener schedules.
Install flashing membrane behind the ledger board and integrate stainless or vinyl Z-flashing over the top edge.

watchOut: Never attach a deck ledger to an open-web floor truss rim board or hollow masonry without engineered details.
Ensure all hardware and fasteners are hot-dip galvanized or stainless steel compatible with ACQ/CA treated wood.

steps.title: Mount house rim joist and backing membrane
steps.detail: Fasten exterior wall sheathing to the rim joist and apply self-adhering waterproofing membrane over the substrate.

steps.title: Position and align ledger board
steps.detail: Level the incised pressure-treated ledger board against the backing membrane and lay out code-required bolt hole spacing.

steps.title: Install staggered through-bolts
steps.detail: Drill through the ledger, sheathing, and rim board in an alternating high-low pattern, inserting 1/2-inch galvanized through-bolts with washers.

steps.title: Fit Z-flashing and upper sealing tape
steps.detail: Set the stainless steel Z-flashing over the top edge of the ledger and lap the vertical leg with self-adhering flashing tape.

steps.title: Fasten joist hangers to ledger
steps.detail: Nail face-mount joist hangers along the ledger face at 400 mm on-centre using approved 10d hanger nails.

steps.title: Seat and nail deck joists
steps.detail: Seat the deck joists squarely into each hanger base and drive diagonal connector nails through the side flanges.

entries.name: Deck Ledger Board & Lateral Tension Tie Assembly
entries.variant: 2x10 treated ledger, 1/2 in staggered through-bolts, DTT2Z lateral ties
entries.material: Pressure-treated 2x10 lumber, 1/2 in hot-dip galvanized bolts, flashing tape, Simpson DTT2Z brackets, threaded rod

tips.frame: Establish ledger elevation accounting for finish deck board thickness below the interior finished floor threshold.
general: Stagger bolt holes top and bottom along the ledger to prevent splitting the band joist grain.
Install non-corrosive self-adhering flashing behind and over the top lip of the ledger board.

watchOut: Ledgers can never be fastened directly to hollow masonry veneer or cantilevered overhangs.
Verify structural washers are installed under both nut and bolt head to avoid wood fiber crushing.

steps.title: Erect house floor framing and rim joist
steps.detail: End-nail house floor joists through the rim board at designated spacing using three 16d common nails per connection.

steps.title: Install peel-and-stick flashing membrane
steps.detail: Apply continuous self-adhering membrane across the face of the band joist, extending above and below the ledger contact zone to protect against moisture intrusion.

steps.title: Mount treated ledger with staggered through-bolts
steps.detail: Level the 2x10 treated ledger against the house rim board, drill 17/32 inch clearance holes, and secure with 1/2 inch hot-dip galvanized bolts and washers in a code-compliant staggered pattern.

steps.title: Install corrosion-resistant Z-flashing cap
steps.detail: Fit galvanized Z-flashing over the top edge of the ledger board with the back leg tucked up behind the house weather barrier.

steps.title: Fasten joist hangers and set deck joists
steps.detail: Nail face-mount joist hangers to the ledger with full-length hanger nails, then seat and toe-nail the treated deck joists into place.

steps.title: Install Simpson DTT2Z lateral tension ties
steps.detail: Mount tension tie brackets to the opposing interior house and deck joists, pass the 1/2 inch threaded rods through pre-drilled holes in the rim and ledger, and torque the nuts securely against heavy washers.

entries.name: Glazier: Demountable Interior Glass Wall Partition
entries.variant: Low-profile aluminum perimeter channels, 1/2 in tempered glass lites, dry-glaze acoustic gaskets
entries.material: Anodized aluminum U-channel tracks, 1/2 in tempered glass, EPDM roll-in wedge gasket, clear polycarbonate H-spline

tips.frame: Fasten floor track and ceiling channel plumb within 1/16 in using a multi-line self-leveling laser.
general: Lift glass with suction cups into deep ceiling channel, slide horizontally, and lower onto neoprene setting blocks in base track.
Join adjacent vertical glass edges with clear polycarbonate H-splines to maintain acoustic seal without metal mullions.

watchOut: Never allow raw edges or corners of tempered glass to contact concrete floors or aluminum channel walls.
Check floor fastener depths to ensure drill bits avoid embedded in-slab post-tension cables or radiant heating pipes.

steps.title: Anchor perimeter aluminum channels
steps.detail: Fasten base channel, deep head channel, and side jambs into floor, ceiling, and adjacent drywall studs with low-profile flathead anchors.

steps.title: Position neoprene setting blocks
steps.detail: Place 85 durometer setting blocks in the floor channel at quarter points beneath each lite location to cushion and isolate glass edges.

steps.title: Hoist and seat first glass lite
steps.detail: Using suction cups, raise the left tempered panel up into the deep ceiling pocket, align vertically, and lower gently onto the setting blocks.

steps.title: Fit dry joint spline and set second lite
steps.detail: Slide the clear polycarbonate H-spline onto the trailing vertical edge of lite 1, then insert lite 2 into the ceiling channel and seat tight against spline.

steps.title: Roll in perimeter acoustic wedge gaskets
steps.detail: Roll continuous EPDM dry-glaze wedge gaskets into the front and back perimeter pockets of base, head, and jamb channels to lock and acoustically seal the glass.

entries.name: Drilled Shaft (Caisson) Rebar Cage Assembly
entries.variant: 36 in diameter cage, twelve #8 vertical bars, #4 continuous spiral hoop at 4 in pitch
entries.material: Grade 60 #8 deformed rebar, Grade 60 #4 spiral rebar hoop, heavy plastic roller wheels, 16-ga double loop ties

tips.frame: Space vertical bars symmetrically on circular steel template rings prior to spinning the continuous rebar spiral.
general: Tie every intersection of the continuous spiral for the top and bottom 3 feet of cage, and alternate ties across the body.
Snap heavy-duty 3-inch circular roller spacers around the cage perimeter at 6 ft vertical intervals to guarantee minimum concrete cover.

watchOut: Install rigid internal pipe cross-bracing to prevent cage ovalization or buckling during horizontal crane rigging and tilt-up.
Ensure all roller wheels spin freely and do not drag flat against drilled rock walls to avoid cage jamming during placement.

steps.title: Set internal stiffener template rings
steps.detail: Set up the lower and upper stiffener template rings to maintain shaft circular geometry and prevent cage collapse.

steps.title: Mount cardinal vertical rebar bars
steps.detail: Erect and tie the four main cardinal #8 rebar bars to the internal stiffeners using double-loop wire ties.

steps.title: Add intermediate vertical rebar
steps.detail: Evenly distribute and wire-tie the remaining eight #8 vertical longitudinal bars around the circumference.

steps.title: Install outer confinement hoops
steps.detail: Position and wire-tie the external #4 confinement hoops along the shaft height at designated intervals.

steps.title: Attach plastic cage roller centralizers
steps.detail: Snap the heavy-duty roller wheels onto the vertical bars at lower and upper tiers to provide required concrete clearance.

entries.name: Dry-Type Transformer Secondary Tap & Grounding
entries.variant: 15 kVA 480V-to-120/208V dry transformer, FMC flex, grounding electrode conductor
entries.material: 15 kVA 3-phase dry transformer, 1-1/4 in flexible metal conduit (FMC), grounding electrode conductor (bare Cu), grounding lug

tips.frame: Mount transformer on neoprene vibration-isolation pads over solid structural housekeeping pad.
general: Bond transformer neutral (X0) to case and grounding electrode conductor to create a separately derived system.
Install flexible metallic conduit with a slack loop to prevent acoustic transformer hum transmitting into walls.

watchOut: Tighten terminal lugs strictly to manufacturer torque values to prevent loose-phase fire hazards.
Verify tap changers on primary windings match site line voltage before energizing secondary circuits.

parts.name: Right side enclosure panel with knockout
Secondary lugs X0 neutral and X1 X2 X3 phases
System bonding jumper (X0 neutral to ground bus)

Secondary feeder conductors into secondary lugs

steps.title: Set base struts and vibration pads
steps.detail: Anchor parallel Unistrut channels to the floor and position neoprene vibration isolation pads at each corner hole location.

steps.title: Place chassis base and core assembly
steps.detail: Lower the transformer chassis pan onto the isolation pads and bolt the laminated 3-phase core assembly firmly in place.

steps.title: Erect rear and side enclosure panels
steps.detail: Fasten the back and side sheet metal ventilation panels to the base frame, keeping the front open for electrical terminations.

steps.title: Bond ground bus and install GEC
steps.detail: Bolt the copper ground busbar to the chassis, secure the lay-in lug, route the bare grounding electrode conductor through the base, and land the system bonding jumper from X0.

steps.title: Land secondary taps and FMC conduit
steps.detail: Install the secondary terminal standoff and mechanical lugs, fit the 1-1/4 in FMC connector into the right panel, and terminate conductors to X0 neutral and phases X1, X2, and X3.

steps.title: Secure top enclosure cover
steps.detail: Fit the louvered drip-proof top cover over the side panels and fasten with sheet metal screws.

entries.name: Mini-Split Evaporator Mount & Flare Connection
entries.variant: 12k BTU wall-hung air handler, 1/4 x 3/8 in line set, flared fittings
entries.material: Galvanized wall bracket, copper line set, closed-cell insulation, flare nuts, nylon drain hose, 14/4 tray cable

tips.frame: Fasten bracket to minimum two wall studs and check cross-level with torpedo.
general: Use an eccentric cone flaring tool and coat flare mating surfaces with POE oil before torquing.
Torque flare nuts strictly to specification using a calibrated digital torque wrench.

watchOut: Overtorquing cracks the flare seat, causing slow refrigerant leaks under high head pressure.
Slope condensate drain downward continuously at 1/4 in per foot; never trap line.

parts.name: Insulation sleeve and vinyl bundle wrap

steps.title: Level and anchor mounting bracket
steps.detail: Fasten the galvanized wall bracket securely into wall studs with a slight tilt toward the drain side, and insert the penetration sleeve.

steps.title: Hang evaporator chassis on kickstand
steps.detail: Latch top clips of the indoor unit onto the bracket plate and prop the bottom outward using the rear maintenance spacer.

steps.title: Feed field line set, drain, and cable
steps.detail: Pass the insulated refrigerant line set, condensate drain hose, and 14/4 control cable through the wall sleeve into the connection trough.

steps.title: Couple and torque flare connections
steps.detail: Align factory copper tails with the line set, coat flare faces with refrigeration oil, and torque both 1/4 inch and 3/8 inch brass flare nuts to specification using dual wrenches.

steps.title: Insulate joints and seal bundle
steps.detail: Slide closed-cell insulation sleeves over the exposed brass flare fittings and wrap the piping, drain tube, and wiring bundle tightly with vinyl finishing tape.

entries.name: Dutch Hip Roof Framing with Mini-Gablet & Jack Rafters
entries.variant: 2x8 hip rafters, Dutch hip horizontal girder tie, mini-gablet wall with 2x4 studs, hip jack rafters (16 in O.C.)
entries.material: #2 Douglas fir 2x8 hip rafters, 2x8 horizontal girder/purlin, 2x6 common rafters, 2x4 gablet studs, hurricane ties

tips.frame: Position the horizontal Dutch hip beam across common rafters at the planned gablet setback distance before dropping hip rafters.
general: Seat the upper ends of the hip rafters against the Dutch hip beam rather than extending all the way to the main ridge.
Frame the vertical mini-gablet wall squarely on top of the cross beam with framed vents or louver rough openings.
Space jack rafters evenly along the lower hip rafter, nailing birdsmouth cuts securely to exterior wall plates.

watchOut: The horizontal Dutch cross girder bears significant transferred roof loads; verify double-ply thickness or engineered sizing.
Ensure hurricane ties fasten both the hip rafter and cross girder securely down to the supporting wall plates.
