Top-right hillside washer and hex nut
Top-left hillside washer and hex nut
Bottom-right hillside washer and hex nut

steps.title: Erect columns and horizontal bay struts
steps.detail: Plumb the structural W8x21 columns and bolt the top eave strut and bottom tie channel between column webs.

steps.title: Install hillside washers at diagonal 1 endpoints
steps.detail: Seat the curved tabs of the ductile iron hillside washers into the slotted web holes at the bottom-left and top-right frame nodes.

steps.title: Hang ascending diagonal rod and turnbuckle
steps.detail: Thread the 7/8 in lower rod into the bottom hillside washer, couple to the open turnbuckle, and connect the upper rod to the top-right washer.

steps.title: Seat hillside washers at diagonal 2 endpoints
steps.detail: Insert the opposing pair of hillside washers into the top-left and bottom-right punched column web slots.

steps.title: Install descending rod assembly and tension bay
steps.detail: Feed the crossing rod segments through the turnbuckle and opposite hillside washers, snug heavy hex nuts, and pretension turnbuckles until taut.

entries.name: Plumber: Wall-Hung Water Closet Carrier & Flush Valve
entries.variant: Siphon-jet cast iron carrier, 4 in no-hub waste, structural feet, and 1 in manual flushometer rough-in
entries.material: Cast iron horizontal carrier, 1/2 in threaded studs, neoprene bowl gasket, 4 in no-hub coupling, chrome flush valve, 1 in copper

tips.frame: Anchor the carrier structural foot brackets to the subfloor with concrete expansion bolts before setting framing around the chase.
general: Adjust carrier threaded studs and backup nuts so bowl mounting torque transfers to the cast-iron frame rather than the drywall.
Verify rough-in centerlines match ADA compliance: 15 to 19 inches from finished floor to toilet seat rim.

watchOut: Never allow porcelain weight to bear onto the drywall face; improper horn extension will crack the ceramic fixture during torquing.
Maintain the vacuum breaker critical level line at least 6 inches above the water closet fixture flood level rim per plumbing code.

parts.name: 4 in no-hub cast iron waste line

steps.title: Anchor carrier footings and upright legs
steps.detail: Set structural feet flat on the concrete slab at layout marks and fasten securely. Bolt the vertical heavy-gauge channel uprights to both feet, verifying plumb in both planes.

steps.title: Mount cast iron carrier body and header strut
steps.detail: Slide the cast iron siphon-jet horizontal barrel and faceplate between uprights, setting the horn center at 380 mm above finished floor. Secure the top cross-strut to brace the uprights.

steps.title: Connect waste run and vent riser
steps.detail: Join the 4 in horizontal cast iron waste branch with a heavy-duty no-hub coupling torqued to 60 in-lb. Connect the 2 in auxiliary vent riser to the carrier top vent tapping.

steps.title: Install waste horn, gasket, and bowl studs
steps.detail: Thread the adjustable waste nipple into the faceplate to finished wall depth and slip on the neoprene closet gasket. Thread in four 1/2 in high-strength bowl support rods with jamb nuts.

steps.title: Rough-in 1 in copper supply and control stop
steps.detail: Run the 1 in rigid copper water supply riser offset 120 mm left of fixture center. Clamp firmly to the strut header with a cushion clamp and terminate with the 1 in chrome angle stop valve.

steps.title: Install chrome manual flushometer valve
steps.detail: Assemble the chrome diaphragm flush valve to the stop tailpiece. Connect the vacuum breaker drop tube down to the 1-1/2 in spud coupling nut and confirm handle clearance.

entries.name: Sound & Utility Staggered-Stud Chase Wall
entries.variant: 2x6 top and bottom plates with alternating 2x4 studs at 8 in offset (16 in O.C. per side)
entries.material: SPF 2x6 plates, SPF 2x4 studs, 3-1/4 in framing nails, closed-cell acoustical plate sealant

tips.frame: Lay out both 2x6 plates together, clearly marking 'A' face and 'B' face stud locations with color-coded pencil lines.
general: Align studs flush to outer plate edges alternately to prevent sound transmission between drywall faces.
Drill holes for plumbing risers dead-center through plates without notching studs beyond code limits.

watchOut: Ensure adjacent offset studs leave adequate clearance for 3 in or 4 in DWV pipe bells.
Apply acoustical sealant along the full bottom plate footprint prior to anchoring to the subfloor.

steps.title: Lay the acoustical sealant gasket
steps.detail: Roll out and trim the continuous closed-cell acoustical gasket directly along the chalk line on the subfloor.

steps.title: Anchor the sole plate
steps.detail: Bed the 2x6 bottom plate firmly onto the acoustical gasket and anchor through to the structural floor.

steps.title: Erect boundary end studs
steps.detail: Stand the full-width 2x6 perimeter studs at both wall ends, plumb them vertically, and end-nail into the sole plate.

steps.title: Nail rear 2x4 studs flush to back plate edge
steps.detail: Layout rear studs at 16 in (406 mm) on centre aligned flush with the back face of the 2x6 sole plate and toenail securely.

steps.title: Nail front 2x4 studs staggered to front plate edge
steps.detail: Install alternating front studs offset 8 in (203 mm) from the rear studs, flush with the front face of the plate to decouple acoustic transmission.

steps.title: Fasten top plate and double cap plate
steps.detail: End-nail the primary 2x6 top plate into each stud head, then face-nail the overlapping 2x6 cap plate to tie the sound partition together.

entries.name: Structural Shear Wall with Hold-Down Anchors
entries.variant: 2x4 studs (16 in O.C.), 1/2 in CDX sheathing, Simpson HDU hold-downs
entries.material: 2x4 SPF framing, 1/2 in CDX plywood, Simpson HDU2 hold-downs, 5/8 in anchor bolts, 8d common nails

tips.frame: Snap layout lines directly on the foundation plate, aligning hold-down anchor bolt centerlines with double end-stud pockets.
general: Maintain 3-inch edge nailing along perimeter studs without splitting chord edges.
Ensure anchor bolt washers fully bed flat against the hold-down bracket base flange.

watchOut: Overdriven nails cut the plywood face veneer and severely degrade rated lateral shear values.
Do not notch or drill end-post tension chords within 12 inches of hold-down hardware.

parts.name: Left 3x3 in plate washer and nut
Right 3x3 in plate washer and nut

steps.title: Set foundation stem and anchor bolts
steps.detail: Verify cast concrete foundation with embedded 5/8-inch hold-down rods and sill plate anchor bolts aligned on centerline.

steps.title: Install and anchor treated sole plate
steps.detail: Drill clearance holes in the treated bottom plate, fit over anchor bolts onto sill gasket, and secure with 3x3 inch plate washers and nuts.

steps.title: Erect boundary double posts and intermediate studs
steps.detail: Nail double 2x4 boundary posts at panel edges and 16-inch on-center field studs to the sole plate with 16d common nails.

steps.title: Fasten double top plates
steps.detail: Cap the framed wall with two staggered 2x4 top plates nailed down into each stud.

steps.title: Mount Simpson HDU hold-downs
steps.detail: Secure HDU2 hold-down brackets to double boundary posts using SDS structural screws and tighten anchor rod nuts over heavy washers.

steps.title: Fasten 1/2 in CDX shear panel
steps.detail: Nail structural plywood to framing with 8d common nails spaced 3 inches on-center along boundaries and 12 inches in the field.

entries.name: Pneumatic Tube Terminal Station & Diverter Loop
entries.variant: 4 in clear polycarbonate carrier tubing, dual-direction station terminal, slide diverter, unistrut brackets
entries.material: 4 in clear polycarbonate tube, steel slide diverter, dispatch terminal box, cushion air piston, unistrut clamps

tips.frame: Mount vertical unistrut stanchions plumb and square to the receiving terminal rough wall opening.
general: Deburr and chamfer all inside tube cut edges to zero tolerance to avoid jamming high-speed transport canisters.
Align optical beam sensors squarely through clear polycarbonate walls to confirm arrival detection.

watchOut: Loose tube joint bands permit vacuum leakage, resulting in canister stalls within inaccessible ceiling chases.
Keep clear bends at a minimum 30-inch radius to prevent rectangular canister wedging.

steps.title: Erect unistrut support frame
steps.detail: Anchor vertical unistrut channels and secure horizontal crossmembers using channel nuts and bolts.

steps.title: Mount station terminal assembly
steps.detail: Fasten the dual-direction dispatch terminal housing to the frame and attach the sealed access door and keypad.

steps.title: Install pneumatic slide diverter
steps.detail: Fix the steel slide diverter body to the upper unistrut section and bolt the shifting air cylinder actuator.

steps.title: Fit clear polycarbonate tubing and clamp bar
steps.detail: Insert the 4-inch polycarbonate send, return, and bypass tubes into the diverter ports and secure with cushion clamps.

steps.title: Place carrier capsule
steps.detail: Seat the pneumatic carrier capsule into the terminal dispatch basket to complete station setup.

entries.name: Carpenter: Pocket Door Frame & Track Installation
entries.variant: Steel-wrapped split studs, aluminum box track, ball-bearing rollers, 32x80 in door rough-in
entries.material: Extruded aluminum header track, steel-encased wood split studs, rubber floor guides, 3-wheel ball-bearing trolleys

tips.frame: Ensure the rough opening header is dead level to prevent gravity creeping of the suspended door slab.
general: Use plumb bobs or a long spirit level on split studs to ensure the pocket stays completely parallel without hourglass pinching.
Hang drywall using 1 in type S screws into split studs to avoid puncturing the internal door clearance pocket.

watchOut: Fasteners protruding into the pocket cavity will deeply gouge the door slab upon initial operation.
Verify finished flooring thickness before anchoring floor guide brackets to prevent binding.

steps.title: Frame rough opening and backer
steps.detail: Plumb and nail king studs to floor and overhead framing, then fasten the top rough header and wood track backer board perfectly level.

steps.title: Fasten extruded aluminum track
steps.detail: Screw the aluminum box track into the underside of the wood backer board, verifying track alignment across the full length.

steps.title: Anchor floor brackets and erect split studs
steps.detail: Fasten metal floor plates to the subfloor and secure the steel-wrapped wood split studs upright between the track backer and floor brackets.

steps.title: Set strike jamb and nylon floor guides
steps.detail: Plumb and nail the strike jamb on the closing stud, then install the bottom centering guides at the mouth of the pocket cavity.

steps.title: Slide trolleys and hang door slab
steps.detail: Roll the 3-wheel ball-bearing trolleys into the box track, engage door hanger brackets onto hanger bolts, and adjust height and plumb.

entries.name: Pocket Door Frame & Split Stud Cage
entries.variant: 2x4 header, aluminum overhead roller track, steel-wrapped split studs (36x80 in door)
entries.material: Galvanized steel-wrapped wood split studs, aluminum jump-proof track, 2x4 header, floor brackets

tips.frame: Frame the rough opening height strictly off the finished floor plane rather than the rough subfloor.
general: Ensure the overhead aluminum track is dead level to prevent gravity-induced door drifting.
Plumb the split jamb studs with a 6 ft level before fastening bottom anchor brackets into concrete or wood subfloor.

watchOut: Fasteners driven into split studs must not penetrate the cavity or they will scratch the door face.
Never run electrical cables or plumbing pipes through the pocket cavity framing.

steps.title: Frame the rough opening
steps.detail: Plumb and nail the pocket rear stud and strike jamb stud, then secure the top rough framing header flush between them.

steps.title: Mount the header and aluminum track
steps.detail: Fasten the wood track backer beneath the rough header and screw the aluminum jump-proof overhead track securely along its centerline.

steps.title: Anchor floor brackets and erect split studs
steps.detail: Fasten galvanized floor brackets to the deck, plumb each pair of steel-wrapped split studs, and screw the tops into the track header.

steps.title: Insert trolleys and install pocket guides
steps.detail: Roll both three-wheel carriages into the track extrusion and fasten the bottom guide clips at the pocket entrance throat.

steps.title: Hang and adjust the door panel
steps.detail: Engage the door hanger plates into the trolley pendant bolts, plumb the slab with the adjustment wrench, and test travel into the cage.

entries.name: Post-Frame Column, Truss Carrier & Bookshelf Girts
entries.variant: 3-ply 2x6 laminated column, dual 2x12 truss carriers, recessed 2x4 bookshelf girts (24 in O.C.)
entries.material: #1 SYP 3-ply glued laminated 2x6 posts, 2x12 truss headers, 2x4 SPF girts, structural timber screws, 1/2 in carriage bolts

tips.frame: Brace columns plumb in two directions using 2x4 diagonal kickers staked into solid ground.
general: Notch the outer plies of the laminated post to provide a direct mechanical bearing shoulder for the 2x12 truss carriers.
Install bookshelf girts flush with post edges to maximize interior clearance and insulation cavities.

watchOut: Never rely solely on bolts in shear to hold truss carriers; the carrier must rest on a notched post seat.
Check post spacing across diagonal diagonals to ensure the entire bay is square before fixing girts.

steps.title: Anchor Base Brackets to Foundation
steps.detail: Lay out post centers at 2000 mm center-to-center. Fasten heavy-gauge U-brackets to the concrete foundation using wedge anchors.

steps.title: Erect and Plumb 3-Ply Columns
steps.detail: Seat the 3-ply 2x6 laminated SYP columns squarely into the U-brackets. Plumb both columns in both axes and secure through bracket flanges.

steps.title: Hang Dual 2x12 Truss Carriers
steps.detail: Clamp the front and rear 2x12 truss headers against the column tops, flush with the top edge of each laminated post.

steps.title: Through-Bolt Headers to Columns
steps.detail: Drill 9/16 in holes through both 2x12 carriers and the column plies. Drive 1/2 in carriage bolts in a staggered pattern and torque nuts over washers.

steps.title: Install Recessed Bookshelf Girts
steps.detail: Install 2x4 SPF bookshelf girts flatwise at 24 in on-center between posts, flush to the exterior face. Fasten each end with structural wood screws.

steps.title: Fasten Mid-Span Vertical Stiffeners
steps.detail: Nail vertical 2x4 spacer blocks between the flat girt courses at mid-span to prevent sag and ensure uniform vertical spacing for exterior cladding.

entries.name: Post-Tensioned Concrete Slab Tendon & Live-End Anchorage
entries.variant: 0.5 in 270k unbonded mono-strand tendon, ductile iron live-end casting, plastic pocket former, hairpin rebar
entries.material: 0.5 in 7-wire steel tendon in extruded poly sheath, iron anchor casting, plastic pocket former, #4 rebar hairpins, tie wire

tips.frame: Drill edge forms at exact engineered elevation marks to establish the correct tendon parabolic profile drape.
general: Nail the plastic pocket former perpendicular to the form board to ensure the hydraulic jack seats flush during stressing.
Position hairpin reinforcement bars within one inch behind the ductile iron bearing plate to control bursting stresses.
Inspect the plastic sheath for tears and tape all exposed cable thoroughly right up to the anchor seal sleeve.

watchOut: Never allow kinks or sharp bends in post-tensioned tendons; minimum radius curves must follow PTI specifications.
Ensure the tendon remains dead-straight for at least twelve inches directly behind the anchor casting.

steps.title: Erect formwork deck and edge bulkhead
steps.detail: Lay the plywood soffit deck flat and fasten the edge bulkhead perpendicular to contain the slab pour.

steps.title: Fasten pocket former and live-end anchor casting
steps.detail: Screw the reusable plastic pocket former through the bulkhead and mount the ductile iron anchor casting flush against it.

steps.title: Install hairpin bursting reinforcement and backup bars
steps.detail: Position the #4 hairpin reinforcement directly behind the casting to resist local bursting stresses, then secure top and bottom transverse backup rebar with tie wire.

steps.title: Place tendon support chair and lay the mono-strand tendon
steps.detail: Position the support chair on the soffit, pass the extruded plastic-sheathed tendon through the casting, and project the bare strand tail through the bulkhead for jack engagement.

entries.name: Cabinet Maker: Laminate Countertop Draw-Bolt Miter
entries.variant: Prefabricated postform countertop blanks, 45-degree miter cut, dog-bone draw bolts, color-matched laminate seamfil
entries.material: Postform laminate tops, steel dog-bone fasteners, wood biscuits, waterproof PVA glue, laminate seam sealer

tips.frame: Dry-fit miter joint on top of base cabinets to verify squareness against out-of-square drywall walls.
general: Rout dog-bone fastener recesses on the countertop underside using a dedicated plunge router template jig.
Coat both raw particleboard core edges with color-matched waterproof seam sealant immediately before drawing bolts tight.

watchOut: Do not over-torque dog-bone draw bolts; excessive clamping force can chip or buckle the laminate decorative edge.
Immediately wipe squeeze-out sealant from the decorative laminate face with approved solvent before it sets.

steps.title: Set and level base cabinets
steps.detail: Position the corner base carcases plumb, level, and flush to provide continuous flat support beneath the miter run.

steps.title: Dry-fit left countertop section
steps.detail: Rest the left postform blank onto the cabinet top stretchers, verifying back wall clearance and miter angle orientation.

steps.title: Insert alignment biscuits with adhesive
steps.detail: Apply waterproof PVA glue into the pre-cut biscuit slots along the 45-degree miter face and seat three #20 beechwood biscuits.

steps.title: Join mating right countertop section
steps.detail: Apply color-matched seam sealer along the laminate top edge and slide the right miter blank over the biscuits until flush.

steps.title: Install and tension dog-bone draw bolts
steps.detail: Drop tite-joint fastener bolts into underside rout pockets and torque nuts evenly with a wrench until the laminate seam closes tight.

entries.name: Precast Box Culvert Joint & Gasket Assembly
entries.variant: 6 ft x 4 ft precast box culvert, tongue-and-groove joint, preformed butyl mastic seal
entries.material: Reinforced concrete box culvert section, flexible butyl sealant rope, external geotextile joint wrap, puller lugs

tips.frame: Verify crushed-stone bedding pad is compacted flat with no crowning before landing the first box culvert barrel.
general: Apply continuous butyl sealant rope around the perimeter tongue profile without stretching or overlapping unevenly.
Draw joint closed uniformly with internal mechanical come-alongs until specified squeeze gap is achieved around all four faces.

watchOut: Never stand inside or between culvert sections while pulling joints together with mechanical hoists.
Clean mating concrete surfaces with wire brushes to guarantee leak-tight seal against hydrostatic groundwater pressure.

Preformed butyl mastic rope seal right wall

steps.title: Prepare aggregate foundation bed
steps.detail: Level and compact the crushed aggregate leveling pad to uniform grade and elevation across the joint footprint.

steps.title: Place downstream culvert barrel section
steps.detail: Set the downstream precast box culvert barrel firmly on grade with the receiving groove facing upstream.

steps.title: Apply flexible butyl mastic rope gasket
steps.detail: Clean the groove shoulder, prime concrete surfaces, and press continuous preformed butyl mastic rope along the bottom, sides, and crown with mitered overlapping corners.

steps.title: Position upstream culvert barrel and mount puller lugs
steps.detail: Lower the adjoining box culvert section onto the bedding, align tongue with groove, and secure internal pulling anchor brackets on cast-in inserts.

steps.title: Pull joint home to uniform homed refusal
steps.detail: Span the hydraulic puller cylinder across lugs and stroke uniformly until the tongue seats completely and butyl gasket compresses to specification.

steps.title: Encase exterior joint with geotextile wrap
steps.detail: Adhere heavy-duty woven geotextile joint wrap completely around the bottom, exterior sidewalls, and crown with minimum 300 mm joint coverage to prevent backfill migration.

entries.name: Parallel Strand Lumber (PSL) Ridge Beam & Rafter Hangers
entries.variant: 3-1/2 x 14 in PSL ridge beam, Simpson HU410 face-mount hangers, and 1-3/4 x 9-1/2 in LVL rafters
entries.material: 3-1/2 x 14 in Parallam PSL beam, 1-3/4 x 9-1/2 in LVL rafters, Simpson HU face-mount hangers, 16d common galvanized nails

tips.frame: Crown and brace the PSL ridge beam plumb on temporary shores before laying out opposing rafter stations.
general: Tack face-mount heavy hangers to the PSL beam at specified roof slope angles using manufacturer hanger nails.
Seat LVL rafters into hanger seats and drive positive double-shear diagonal nails through rafter into the beam.

watchOut: Ensure all specified hanger nail holes are filled; omitting nails into PSL reduces structural roof uplift resistance.
Do not bevel cut LVL rafters undersized; rafter heel must fully engage the hanger seat.

steps.title: Set Base Plates and Erect Support Posts
steps.text: Position treated base plates on the floor layout marks and plumb the solid timber support posts.

steps.title: Install Steel Column Caps
steps.text: Fit heavy-gauge steel column caps over the post heads and fasten through pre-drilled holes.

steps.title: Hoist and Secure PSL Ridge Beam
steps.text: Lift the 3-1/2 x 14 in Parallam PSL beam into the column cap saddles and secure with through-bolts.

steps.title: Fasten Simpson HU Face-Mount Hangers
steps.text: Layout rafter stations and nail Simpson HU face-mount hangers to both faces of the PSL beam with 16d common galvanized nails.

steps.title: Seat and Nail LVL Rafters
steps.text: Drop the 1-3/4 x 9-1/2 in LVL rafters squarely into hanger stirrups and complete positive angle joist nailing.

entries.name: Radius Curved Stud Wall Framing
entries.variant: Dual-layer 3/4 in kerfed plywood curved plates (5 ft radius), 2x4 studs at 12 in O.C.
entries.material: 3/4 in ACX plywood plates, SPF 2x4 studs, 3 in framing nails, structural wood adhesive

tips.frame: Establish a trammel arm from a fixed center-point nail on the shop floor to swing consistent curved plate arcs.
general: Laminate two layers of 3/4 in plywood with staggered butt joints and glue to build rigid top and bottom tracks.
Plumb studs vertically using a laser level, turning stud edges slightly to follow the curved perimeter tangents.

watchOut: Do not space studs wider than 12 in on center; tighter spacing is required to support curved gypsum board.
Secure the curved bottom plate into subfloor joists or concrete anchors at least every 16 in.

parts.name: Sole plate bottom plywood layer (5 ft radius)
Sole plate top plywood layer (staggered seams)
Top plate cap plywood layer (staggered seams)

steps.title: Set the primary curved sole plate template
steps.detail: Snap the 5 ft radius arc on the deck and align the 3/4 in plywood sub-sole segments along the layout line.

steps.title: Laminate the secondary sole plate layer
steps.detail: Apply structural adhesive and fasten the second plywood layer with butt joints offset by half a bay.

steps.title: Plumb and toenail lead and apex studs
steps.detail: Stand the end studs and apex center stud, aligning each radial axis perpendicular to the arc tangent.

steps.title: Infill remaining radial studs
steps.detail: Position intermediate studs at 12 in on-center arc spacing and toenail securely into the laminated plate.

steps.title: Install curved mid-span blocking
steps.detail: Nail flat blocking segments between studs at 1220 mm height to prevent stud twist and provide drywall backing.

steps.title: Fasten lower curved top plate
steps.detail: Cap the studs with the first 3/4 in plywood top plate arc, end-nailing two 16d nails into each radial stud end.

steps.title: Laminate staggered top cap plate
steps.detail: Apply construction adhesive and nail the staggered cap plate through to lock the wall curvature rigidly.

entries.name: Reduced Beam Section (Dogbone) Seismic Moment Connection
entries.variant: W14x99 column, W18x50 girder with radius flange cutouts, 1/2 in shear tab, A325 high-strength bolts, CJP welds
entries.material: A992 W-flange steel, weld backing bars, run-off tabs, 1/2 in shear tab plate, 7/8 in A325 structural bolts, E7018 electrodes

tips.frame: Layout the dogbone radius profile with a steel template starting at least one-half flange width away from the column face.
general: Grind thermal cut edges in the reduced area parallel to the beam length to a smooth 500-microinch finish to eliminate stress risers.
Snug the bolted web shear tab completely prior to depositing complete-joint-penetration (CJP) groove welds on the flanges.
Remove backing bars and back-gouge the weld root to sound metal when specified for high-seismic demand categories.

watchOut: Avoid arc strikes or gouge gouges across the reduced flange section as they create severe stress concentrations during seismic cycles.
Maintain continuous preheat and interpass temperatures specified by AWS D1.1 to prevent hydrogen-induced heat-affected zone cracking.

steps.title: Erect column and anchor to base
steps.detail: Plumb the W14x99 column over the 1-1/2 in base plate and secure anchor bolts to bearing torque.

steps.title: Fit and weld continuity stiffener plates
steps.detail: Tack and complete double-sided CJP and fillet welds on the four continuity plates aligned with incoming beam flange levels.

steps.title: Weld beam web shear tab
steps.detail: Position the 1/2 in shear tab on the column face with the correct vertical bolt line spacing and fillet weld both sides.

steps.title: Hang RBS girder and torque web bolts
steps.detail: Fly the W18x50 dogbone girder into position against the shear tab and snug-tighten then pretension four 7/8 in A325 bolts.

steps.title: Attach backing bars and runoff tabs
steps.detail: Clamp weld backing bars flush beneath the root opening and tack extension runoff tabs to each flange edge.

steps.title: Deposit CJP flange moment welds
steps.detail: Deposit multi-pass complete joint penetration groove welds on both girder flanges using E7018 electrodes and thermal preheat.

entries.name: RF Shielding Copper Foil Seam & Fingerstock Joint
entries.variant: 3 oz electrolytic copper sheet, soldered flat seam, beryllium copper contact fingerstock, brass clamping battens
entries.material: 3 oz copper foil, rosin-core solder, brass clamping flat bar, beryllium copper fingerstock, brass screws

tips.frame: Ensure plywood substrate backing is completely smooth with countersunk fasteners before foil application.
general: Thoroughly clean copper surfaces with scotch-brite and apply non-acid paste flux prior to soldering.
Sweat continuous solder seams with high-wattage heavy irons to guarantee unbroken electrical conductivity.

watchOut: Pinholes or cold solder joints create electromagnetic radio frequency leaks, failing MRI room attenuation tests.
Do not use steel screws or carbon fasteners that generate galvanic corrosion against brass and copper.

steps.title: Erect backing wall framing
steps.detail: Assemble the sole and top plates with perimeter studs, center seam backing stud, and mid-height fire blocking. Fasten each stud end using two 16d framing nails.

steps.title: Fasten RF plywood substrate
steps.detail: Hang the 19 mm smooth-faced plywood substrate flush to the framing grid. Drive drywall screws at 200 mm perimeter and 300 mm field spacing to guarantee a rigid backing.

steps.title: Hang overlapping 3 oz copper foil sheets
steps.detail: Apply the left copper foil sheet flat against the substrate, then position the right sheet overlapping by 50 mm directly over the center backing stud. Clean mating surfaces with scotch-brite.

steps.title: Sweat-solder the copper seam
steps.detail: Apply mild rosin flux between the 50 mm copper overlap and run a continuous 60/40 solder bead down the joint with an electric soldering iron, eliminating all RF leakage pinholes.

steps.title: Install BeCu fingerstock and brass clamping battens
steps.detail: Position the beryllium copper fingerstock along the RF contact threshold and mount brass clamping flat bars around the perimeter using countersunk brass machine screws.

entries.name: Chimney Roof Cricket (Saddle) Valley Framing
entries.variant: 2x4 ridge board, dual 2x4 valley sleeper plates, bevel-cut 2x4 cricket jack rafters, 1/2 in OSB decking
entries.material: #2 SPF 2x4 lumber, 1/2 in OSB sheathing panels, 8d ring-shank nails, 16d common framing nails, flashing cleats

tips.frame: Establish the cricket apex height against the chimney back wall to ensure pitch exceeds the main roof slope for positive drainage.
general: Bevel the bottom edge of the two angled valley sleeper boards to bed tightly onto the sloped roof plywood decking.
Cut short cricket common and jack rafters with double compound miters matching both ridge and valley angles.
Leave a 1/2 in expansion clearance between cricket framing and masonry chimney faces to accommodate settling.

watchOut: Code mandates a roof cricket for any chimney or curb projection wider than thirty inches perpendicular to roof slope.
Maintain non-combustible clearance requirements between wood cricket framing members and masonry chimneys.

steps.title: Construct the main sloped roof base platform
steps.detail: Assemble the sill plates and rear riser wall, set 2x6 rafters at a 6:12 slope, and fasten 15 mm roof decking to establish the primary roof plane.

steps.title: Erect chimney back wall framing and backer sheathing
steps.detail: Frame and fasten the chimney back wall studs, plates, and backer board plumb to simulate the chimney chase interrupting the roof drainage.

steps.title: Snap chalk lines and fasten dual valley sleepers
steps.detail: Layout the valley lines from the high cricket apex to the outer chimney corners and nail the 2x4 valley sleepers flat through the roof decking into rafters.

steps.title: Set the cricket ridge post and horizontal ridge board
steps.detail: Nail the vertical king post against the chimney face and seat the level 2x4 ridge board spanning from the chimney back to the roof deck intersection.

steps.title: Frame chimney gable rafters and bevel-cut jack rafters
steps.detail: Bevel-cut 2x4 jack rafters at compound angles and toenail them from the cricket ridge board down to the valley sleeper plates on both drainage flanks.

steps.title: Fasten 1/2 in OSB cricket sheathing panels
steps.detail: Fit and secure the OSB sheathing panels to the jack rafters using 8d ring-shank nails spaced 150 mm on centre along all edges.

steps.title: Install valley flashing and chimney counter-flashing cleats
steps.detail: Fasten galvanized valley flashing cleats along both sleeper troughs and install the chimney headwall apron cleat to ensure watertight transitions.

entries.name: Gable Roof Dormer Valley Rafter & Trimmer Framing
entries.variant: Double 2x10 trimmer rafters, 2x8 valley rafter, 2x6 dormer common rafters, dormer sidewalls
entries.material: 2x10 Douglas fir trimmers, 2x8 valley boards, 2x6 rafters/studs, Simpson VPA variable pitch connectors, 16d sinkers

tips.frame: Double the main roof rafters flanking the dormer opening before cutting common rafters.
general: Lay out dormer sidewall bottom plates directly across the double trimmers, plumbing wall studs to the dormer plates.
Cut the valley rafter foot with a compound bevel to seat flush on the dormer roof deck and structural valley plate.

watchOut: Ensure dormer corner studs bear directly over doubled trimmer rafters, not intermediate unsupported sheathing.
Double-check valley rafter line deductions for ridge board and trimmer thicknesses prior to making cuts.

steps.title: Set Support Plates and Trimmer Rafters
steps.detail: Anchor the double front wall plate and rear support beam. Position double 2x10 trimmer rafters flanking the 900 mm dormer opening and secure with Simpson VPA connectors.

steps.title: Install Upper and Lower Structural Headers
steps.detail: Nail double 2x10 headers perpendicular to the roof slope between trimmers to frame the rough opening and support cut common rafters.

steps.title: Frame Dormer Sidewalls and Front Opening
steps.detail: Erect bevel-cut sidewall studs directly over the double trimmer rafters, secure level 2x4 top plates at 1280 mm, and frame the front window rough opening.

steps.title: Set Dormer Ridge and Valley Rafters
steps.detail: Install the 2x8 dormer ridge level back to the main roof intersection. Seat 2x8 valley rafters on compound cheek cuts from ridge to sidewalls and fasten with VPA clips.

steps.title: Install Dormer Commons, Valley Jacks, and Overhang
steps.detail: Fasten 2x6 common rafters along the dormer sidewalls, compound-cut valley jack rafters into the valley boards, and hang front gable fly rafters.

entries.name: Roof Smoke Vent Hatch with Gas Spring Actuators
entries.variant: 48x48 in insulated double-leaf curb, 165°F fusible release latch, dual nitrogen gas struts, curb flashing flange
entries.material: 14-ga galvanized steel curb, aluminum hatch doors, 1 in rigid polyiso insulation, nitrogen gas cylinders, EPDM seals

tips.frame: Square the roof curb over the structural roof deck opening, verifying diagonal dimensions within 1/8 inch.
general: Fasten curb mounting flanges directly to structural roof framing with self-drilling heavy structural screws.
Install the calibrated 165°F fusible release link between internal spring-loaded latch release arms.

watchOut: Stay clear of leaf swing paths when disengaging safety shipping retainers; gas springs pop covers open with intense force.
Verify manual interior and exterior pull cables move freely without binding against insulation or roof gravel.

steps.title: Anchor perimeter curb flashing flanges
steps.detail: Lay out the four galvanized curb base flanges flat around the 48x48 inch roof opening and fasten through prepunched holes into the roof deck.

steps.title: Erect insulated curb walls
steps.detail: Stand the 14-gauge galvanized insulated curb walls on the base flanges and bolt the corner seams plumb and square.

steps.title: Adhere perimeter seals and hang heavy-duty hinges
steps.detail: Press continuous EPDM bulb gaskets along all curb top rims and fasten heavy-duty continuous piano hinges on the east and west outer walls.

steps.title: Mount insulated double hatch leaves and astragal
steps.detail: Bolt the insulated aluminum hatch leaves to the continuous hinges and secure the center overlap astragal to ensure a weather-tight joint.

steps.title: Install nitrogen gas spring actuators
steps.detail: Fasten pivot brackets to the curb interiors and door leaf framing, then pin the pressurized nitrogen gas struts into position.

steps.title: Assemble 165°F fusible link and release handles
steps.detail: Fasten the center mechanical latch box with the UL-listed 165°F fusible link, then connect the interior manual pull cable and exterior release turn handle.

entries.name: Solar Tech: Rooftop PV Combiner Box & Rapid Shutdown
entries.variant: Dual string 10 AWG PV wire, 600V DC disconnect, touch-safe fuse holders
entries.material: NEMA 4X fiberglass combiner box, 15A 1000V DC midget fuses, surge protective device (SPD), 10 AWG PV wire, MC4 connectors

tips.frame: Mount NEMA 4X box onto solar racking uprights using stainless channel strut and hardware.
general: Crimp MC4 connector pins using a ratcheting solar crimper and tighten gland nuts with dedicated disconnect wrenches.
Group positive and negative string conductors in parallel pairs to minimize inductive lightning loops.

watchOut: Direct current (DC) arcs do not self-extinguish; never unplug MC4 connectors or open fuse holders while under load.
Failing to install the DC surge protective device (SPD) leaves sensitive inverter electronics vulnerable to induced grid spikes.

parts.name: NEMA 4X fiberglass hinged door with rotary interlock

steps.title: Anchor Backer Board and Horizontal Strut Rails
steps.desc: Secure the backer panel plumb and square, then bolt the two horizontal strut channels across the board.

steps.title: Mount Combiner Tub and Interior Subpanel
steps.desc: Hang the NEMA 4X fiberglass tub onto the strut rails using stainless strut nuts and set the galvanized interior chassis plate.

steps.title: Install DIN Rail and DC Protection Equipment
steps.desc: Fasten the DIN rail to the subpanel plate and snap in touch-safe fuse blocks, the surge arrestor, and the DC disconnect body.

steps.title: Install Rapid Shutdown Station and Conduit
steps.desc: Mount the adjacent rapid shutdown control enclosure to the rails and install the liquidtight conduit between the enclosures.

steps.title: Fit MC4 Bulkhead Plate and Hang Combiner Door
steps.desc: Seat the bottom MC4 string feed-through assembly with O-ring gaskets and attach the hinged front door with rotary interlock handle.

entries.name: Sauna Vapor Barrier & Cedar T&G Paneling
entries.variant: 1x4 T&G clear cedar, foil vapor retarder, 1x2 furring strips (16 in O.C.), 2x4 bench cleat
entries.material: 1x4 Western red cedar, aluminum foil vapor barrier, high-temp foil tape, 1x2 furring strips, stainless finish nails

tips.frame: Plumb and align furring strips vertically over studs with counter-sunk exterior screws.
general: Overlap foil vapor barrier sheets by 4 inches and seal every seam with high-temperature foil tape.
Blind-nail tongue-and-groove cedar through the tongue using stainless steel finish nails to hide penetrations.

watchOut: Never use plastic poly vapor barriers behind sauna walls; heat degradation releases toxic off-gas fumes.
Ensure an unbroken 3/4-inch ventilation air gap behind the cedar paneling to prevent mold and wood rot.

steps.title: Erect stud wall frame
steps.detail: Lay the sole plate, stand 2x4 framing studs at regular layout centres, and secure the top plate with two 16d nails per stud end.

steps.title: Apply sauna foil vapor barrier and tape seams
steps.detail: Staple aluminum vapor retarder over stud faces with reflective side inward; seal all horizontal laps with heat-resistant foil tape to lock out moisture.

steps.title: Mount vertical furring strips
steps.detail: Fasten 1x2 furring strips vertically directly over studs to form a 3/4-inch continuous convective air gap behind the paneling.

steps.title: Install cedar tongue and groove paneling
steps.detail: Blind-nail horizontal 1x4 Western red cedar paneling tongue-up into furring strips using stainless finish nails, keeping board gaps tight.

steps.title: Fasten bench support cleat
steps.detail: Level and secure the 2x4 cedar bench cleat horizontally through the paneling and furring into wall studs with structural stainless screws.

entries.name: Crawlspace Cripple Wall & Shear Plywood
entries.variant: 2x4 studs at 16 in O.C., 1/2 in CDX plywood sheathing, A35 framing clips, HDU hold-downs
entries.material: Pressure-treated 2x4 mudsill, SPF studs and top plate, 1/2 in structural CDX plywood, Simpson HDU2 hold-downs

tips.frame: Anchor the treated mudsill with foundation sill plate washers before establishing cripple stud heights.
general: Nail structural plywood with 8d common nails spaced 4 in on center along edges and 12 in in the field.
Install continuous solid rim-joist blocking above the top plate to transfer diaphragm loads into the cripple wall.

watchOut: Leave a 1/8 in expansion gap between edges of exterior CDX plywood sheets to prevent buckling.
Verify hold-down anchor bolts are embedded with proper edge clearance in the concrete stem wall.

steps.title: Set and anchor the pressure-treated mudsill
steps.detail: Lay the 2x4 sill over foundation anchor bolts with square plate washers and tighten down level.

steps.title: Stand and toenail cripple studs
steps.detail: Erect corner post pairs and field studs at 16 inches on center, securing each base with 16d common nails.

steps.title: Cap with double top plate
steps.detail: Fasten the lower and upper top plates flush to the cripple studs, staggering any joints.

steps.title: Install hold-downs and framing clips
steps.detail: Mount HDU2 hold-downs to the doubled end studs and secure intermediate studs to the sill using A35 framing clips.

steps.title: Fasten 1/2-inch CDX shear plywood
steps.detail: Hang the CDX panel flush from mudsill to top plate and nail edges at 4 inches on center with 8d common nails.

entries.name: Floor Seismic Expansion Joint with Centering Bar
entries.variant: 4 in expansion gap, aluminum floor plates, pantograph centering spring mechanism, Santoprene moisture seal
entries.material: 6063-T6 aluminum floor cover, continuous Santoprene moisture barrier, stainless steel centering bar, expansion anchors

tips.frame: Clean and vacuum the concrete blockout recess, checking slab edges for squareness and level plane.
general: Unroll elastomeric moisture membrane into blockout groove, draping excess down the structural expansion joint.
Position the pantograph centering bars inside the base channels before securing the top aluminum tread plates.

watchOut: Rigid fasteners must never bridge across the structural expansion gap, which locks movement and causes catastrophic shear.
Anchor only the base frame extrusions into blockout concrete, leaving central glide plates free to float.

steps.title: Establish blockouts and verify structural gap
steps.detail: Verify the nominal 100 mm structural expansion gap between concrete floor slabs and ensure rebate ledges are clean and level.

steps.title: Lay continuous Santoprene moisture seal
steps.detail: Drape the continuous moisture barrier into the joint cavity with uniform slack to accommodate full seismic movement cycles.

steps.title: Anchor aluminum base retainers
steps.detail: Set the extruded aluminum base frames over the moisture seal flanges and secure into the blockout ledge with expansion anchors.

steps.title: Insert acoustic cushion gaskets
steps.detail: Press Santoprene isolation gaskets into the base frame retention channels to eliminate metal-on-metal rattle under traffic.

steps.title: Install pantograph centering bar mechanisms
steps.detail: Engage the stainless steel centering bars into the base frame runner tracks with spring-loaded nylon glide ends aligned.

steps.title: Mount aluminum floor cover plate
steps.detail: Center the serrated floor plate over the joint cavity and engage the center pivot lugs onto the centering bar pivot pins.

entries.name: Shed Roof Framing with Birdsmouth Rafter Cuts
entries.variant: 2x8 rafters (24 in O.C.), 4:12 pitch birdsmouth, structural ledger
entries.material: 2x8 SPF rafters, 2x8 wall ledger, 2x4 bearing wall plates, Simpson H2.5A hurricane ties, 10d nails

tips.frame: Calculate plumb cut and level seat cut using framing square pitch clips before laying out repetitive rafters from a master pattern.
general: Seat cuts must not exceed the depth of the top plate to ensure full bearing surface.
Keep the heel cut height consistent across all rafters so overhang facia aligns dead flat.

watchOut: Over-cutting the birdsmouth seat into the rafter body significantly weakens the cantilever tail.
Temporary rafter brace sticks must remain securely nailed until roof collar ties or sheathing is applied.

parts.name: Bearing wall stud bank (24 in O.C.)

steps.title: Frame and erect the front bearing wall
steps.detail: Anchor the sole plate, stand 2x4 studs at 24 inches on centre, and nail the lower and upper top plates with staggered laps.

steps.title: Fasten structural wall ledger and sloped hangers
steps.detail: Level and through-bolt the 2x8 ledger board to the existing wall studs in a staggered pattern, then secure the sloped rafter hangers.

steps.title: Set rafters with birdsmouth seats
steps.detail: Drop the 4:12 cut rafters into the rear hangers and bed the birdsmouth horizontal seat cuts firmly across the double top plate.

steps.title: Secure hurricane ties and attach sub-fascia
steps.detail: Nail Simpson H2.5A hurricane ties to bind each rafter to the top plates against uplift, then nail the 2x8 sub-fascia square across the plumb tails.

steps.title: Install roof deck sheathing
steps.detail: Lay CDX plywood panels flush to the fascia line with a 1/8 inch expansion gap and nail along rafter chords at 6 inches on edges and 12 inches intermediate.

entries.name: Commercial Sheet Vinyl: Integral Flash Cove & Heat-Welded Seam
entries.variant: 2 mm homogeneous vinyl, 7/8 in cove fillet, 4 mm PVC rod heat weld
entries.material: Homogeneous sheet vinyl, cove fillet strip, capping bar, acrylic vinyl adhesive, 4 mm PVC welding rod

tips.frame: Adhere cove fillet support sticks tight to the floor-wall juncture and snap a level pencil line for capping track.
general: Groove the joined vinyl seam to two-thirds depth using a hand U-groover or electric router.
Preheat the hot-air welding nozzle to 350-400°C and feed rod smoothly without stretching or scorching.

watchOut: Trim excess weld rod in two passes: first pass while warm using a spatula knife with slide guide, second pass flush once cool.
Trapped air blisters under vinyl will cause bubbling; roll thoroughly with a 100 lb segmented roller.

steps.title: Establish subfloor and wall backing
steps.detail: Cast the level concrete floor slab and erect the wall stud framing with smooth backer board.

steps.title: Install cove fillet and capping strip
steps.detail: Adhere the 7/8 in cove fillet into the wall-floor junction and secure the vinyl cove cap profile 150 mm up the wall.

steps.title: Lay and flash-cove vinyl sheets
steps.detail: Roll out homogeneous vinyl sheets into acrylic adhesive, curving over the fillet and locking into the capping trim.

steps.title: Heat-weld and skive seam
steps.detail: Groove the sheet seam to two-thirds depth, fuse the 4 mm PVC rod using a hot-air gun, and skive flush with a quarter-moon knife.

entries.name: Shooting Range Steel Deflector & Anti-Ricochet Baffle
entries.variant: 3/8 in AR500 ballistic plate, 45-degree angle bracket, 3/4 in exterior plywood facing, acoustical rubber isolator
entries.material: 3/8 in AR500 ballistic steel, 3/4 in ACX plywood, structural steel clips, Grade 8 bolts, neoprene isolators

tips.frame: Verify structural ceiling clip angles are precisely set to downrange 45-degree deflection pitch.
general: Mount timber plywood sacrificial facing with uniform 1-inch standoff gaps to capture bullet splatter.
Torque all structural Grade 8 bolts with hardened steel washers to specified engineering values.

watchOut: Never substitute standard mild A36 steel for certified AR500 armor steel plates on live-fire baffles.
Verify zero forward-facing bolt heads or bare metal edges to prevent hazardous backwards ricochets.

steps.title: Assemble structural base and columns
steps.detail: Bolt the left and right base channel skids to the rear tie tube, then erect the twin structural vertical columns.

steps.title: Erect header and 45-degree angle rafters
steps.detail: Fasten the top structural header tube and tie the two 45-degree support rafters between the skids and vertical columns with Grade 8 fasteners.

steps.title: Mount the AR500 ballistic deflector plate
steps.detail: Hoist the 3/8 in AR500 steel plate onto the rafter bed at 45 degrees and secure using countersunk Grade 8 through-bolts.

steps.title: Install acoustical rubber isolator
steps.detail: Lay the 3/8 in acoustical neoprene sheet directly over the AR500 ballistic plate to decouple vibration and dampen firearm report.

steps.title: Fasten standoff bars and anti-ricochet plywood
steps.detail: Secure perimeter standoff spacing bars and screw the 3/4 in exterior plywood facing down to capture bullet splatter and prevent backsplash.

entries.name: Structural Insulated Panel (SIP) Wall-to-Wall Spline Joint
entries.variant: 6-1/2 in EPS foam core SIP panels, twin 7/16 in OSB block splines, expandable urethane foam sealant, structural screws
entries.material: 6-1/2 in SIP panels with 7/16 in OSB skins, 4 in wide OSB surface splines, low-expansion SIP urethane foam adhesive, 1-5/8 in screws

tips.frame: Verify bottom plate sole layout is perfectly plumb and square before lowering the first SIP wall panel into position.
general: Dispense two continuous, heavy beads of expandable sealant into the foam edge pockets before inserting splines.
Slide the OSB block splines halfway into the edge of the seated panel and fasten with ring-shank nails or screws at 6 in O.C.
Pull panels together using a ratcheting come-along and panel-pulling plates until the factory joint gap is less than 1/8 in.

watchOut: Seal all spline joints immediately to prevent thermal leaks and condensation accumulation inside panel foam cores.
Never leave exposed EPS foam cores unprotected from UV radiation or solvent-based chemicals that degrade foam.

parts.name: Expanding urethane foam sealant core bead

steps.title: Anchor the bottom sill plate
steps.detail: Position the treated 2x6 sill plate over the chalk line and torque down the foundation anchor bolts flush with washers.

steps.title: Erect and plumb the left SIP panel
steps.detail: Lower the left panel over the sill plate so the lumber registers fully into the bottom core recess, then check for plumb.

steps.title: Insert twin OSB surface splines
steps.detail: Slide the 4-inch wide OSB splines 2 inches into the interior and exterior factory pockets behind the panel skins.

steps.title: Apply expanding urethane foam sealant
steps.detail: Run a continuous heavy bead of low-expansion SIP urethane foam sealant vertically along the exposed EPS foam core between splines.

steps.title: Join the right SIP panel
steps.detail: Engage the right panel's routed pockets over the protruding splines and slide tight against the expanding foam bead.

steps.title: Cap with top plate and fasten joint
steps.detail: Seat the continuous 2x6 top plate flush into the top panel recess and screw both OSB skins off into the splines at 6 inches on center.

entries.name: Skylight Roof Rough Opening with Double Trimmers
entries.variant: Double 2x8 trimmer rafters, double 2x8 headers, tail rafters (16 in O.C.)
entries.material: 2x8 dimensional lumber, Simpson LUC28 face-mount joist hangers, 10d x 1-1/2 in hanger nails, 16d common nails

tips.frame: Square the opening corner-to-corner using 3-4-5 triangulation or equal diagonal measurements before nailing hangers.
general: Frame the rough opening exactly 1/2 inch wider and taller than the skylight manufacturer curb dimension.
Double trimmer rafters must run continuous from wall plate to ridge to support cut rafter loads.

watchOut: Support cut tail rafters with temporary wall shores before severing roof members with a reciprocating saw.
Fill every single round and diamond hole in structural metal joist hangers with specified structural nails.

steps.title: Set base skids and bottom plate
steps.detail: Position the two 2x8 floor outriggers flat on the ground and fasten the 1300 mm sill plate square across them.

steps.title: Erect common and outer trimmer rafters
steps.detail: Stand the outer common rafters and outer trimmer rafters on the sill plate and secure the top ridge plate across their top ends.

steps.title: Laminate inner trimmer rafters
steps.detail: Face-nail the inner 2x8 trimmers directly to the outer trimmers using 16d common nails staggered at 300 mm centers to form structural double trimmers.

steps.title: Hang double headers
steps.detail: Install Simpson LUC28 face-mount hangers to the inner trimmers at the rough opening elevation and seat the doubled 2x8 upper and lower headers.

steps.title: Install tail rafters and hangers
steps.detail: Center the tail rafters on the 16-inch layout line between plates and headers, locking them into the rough opening with LUC28 hangers and 10d hanger nails.

entries.name: Soil Nail Wall Bearing Plate & Shotcrete Facing
entries.variant: Threadbar soil nail #8, 8x8x1/2 in bearing plate, spherical washer, welded wire mesh facing
entries.material: 1 in Grade 75 all-thread bar, 8x8x1/2 in steel plate, spherical washer and hex nut, 4x4-W4/W4 welded wire fabric

tips.frame: Position welded wire mesh over freshly cut earth face with 1-1/2 in spacers clear of soil prior to shotcrete nozzle application.
general: Slide beveled bearing plate and spherical washer onto protruding threadbar while primary shotcrete is still green.
Hand-tighten hex nut until plate sits firmly against wire mesh facing, then torque to engineer-specified lock-off value.

watchOut: Blow back loose rebound sand and debris from around the bar head before embedding the plate in secondary shotcrete.
Inspect centralizers on underground bar length to ensure anchor rod is not resting against bare soil inside the grout column.

steps.title: Prepare cut face and vertical drainage
steps.detail: Trim soil face to neat line and fasten geocomposite strip drain vertically down the excavation cut.

steps.title: Drill hole and insert soil nail threadbar
steps.detail: Drill 150 mm hole, pump cementitious grout column, and advance #8 continuously threaded bar to target bond depth.

steps.title: Install welded wire mesh and waler rebars
steps.detail: Position 4x4-W4/W4 welded wire fabric over nail head and tie two #4 continuous horizontal waler bars across the nail location.

steps.title: Apply initial shotcrete facing lift
steps.detail: Pneumatically shoot 75 mm structural shotcrete embedment layer around wire mesh and waler bars, leaving nail projection clean.

steps.title: Mount bearing plate and torque hex nut
steps.detail: Slide 8x8x1/2 inch bearing plate flat against shotcrete, place spherical seat washer, and torque heavy hex nut to specified lock-off tension.

entries.name: Commercial Flat Roof Solar Ballasted Racking
entries.variant: 10-degree tilt aluminum chassis, concrete ballast blocks, and microinverter
entries.material: Anodized aluminum racking feet, concrete ballast blocks, EPDM roof slip sheets, microinverter, grounding lugs

tips.frame: Snap chalk lines aligned to true south and set rubber protection pads beneath every racking foot.
general: Torque mid-clamps and end-clamps to manufacturer specifications using calibrated torque drivers.
Route microinverter branch trunk cabling through integrated chassis clips to avoid roof surface contact.

watchOut: Confirm ballast block counts and layout strictly adhere to the project site-specific wind engineering map.

steps.title: Position EPDM slip sheets and ballast pans
steps.desc: Lay the protective EPDM sacrificial slip sheets directly on the roof membrane at the planned footprint corners, then set the aluminum ballast trays squarely on top.

steps.title: Erect front and rear tilt stanchions with cross rails
steps.desc: Bolt the short front and tall rear stanchions to the base pans to establish the 10-degree incline, then mount the front and rear cross rails.

steps.title: Place concrete ballast blocks and attach wind deflector
steps.desc: Load solid concrete ballast blocks into the base trays according to engineering wind-load schedules and fasten the rear aerodynamic wind deflector.

steps.title: Mount microinverter and install equipment grounding lug
steps.desc: Fasten the microinverter to the underside of the rear cross rail and secure the lay-in equipment grounding lug to ensure frame bonding.

steps.title: Set solar module and secure with rail clamps
steps.desc: Rest the solar module across the angled rails, align flush with frame edges, and torque all four aluminum end clamps to lock the panel in place.

entries.name: Solar Thermal Glycol Pump Station & Expansion Tank
entries.variant: Pre-assembled dual-line solar station, heat exchanger loop, solar expansion tank
entries.material: Brass solar pump station with integrated flowmeter, high-temp EPDM solar expansion tank, 3/4 in copper, brass fill/drain valves

tips.frame: Bolt solar station bracket to wall backing using structural lag screws.
general: Install the solar-rated expansion tank with connection pointing up to keep vapor away from bladder.
Ensure check valves in pump pack are set to manual bypass when performing glycol charging.

watchOut: Use only solar-grade propylene glycol; standard automotive ethylene glycol is toxic and forbidden.
Relief valve discharge must be hard-piped to a heat-resistant glycol catch vessel, never to grade.

parts.name: Solar flow line with isolation valve
Solar safety group and expansion port

steps.title: Anchor backer board and strut channels
steps.detail: Fasten the marine plywood backer board to the wall framing and secure two horizontal strut channels using structural screws.

steps.title: Mount station base and flow line assembly
steps.detail: Seat the molded EPP rear insulation shell onto the strut bracket and insert the pre-assembled collector supply line and flowmeter block.

steps.title: Bolt circulation pump and solar safety group
steps.detail: Install the solar circulation pump between the flowmeter and safety group, tightening union nuts with solar-rated flat gaskets.

steps.title: Mount expansion tank wall bracket and vessel
steps.detail: Anchor the cantilevered vessel bracket to the right side of the backer board and thread the 24-litre solar expansion tank into position.

steps.title: Connect flexible stainless expansion line
steps.detail: Run the flexible corrugated stainless connection line from the 3/4-inch safety group port to the expansion vessel service valve.

steps.title: Secure loop copper stubs and front insulation cover
steps.detail: Seat the top and bottom copper piping stubs into the compression unions and press the front EPP thermal shell firmly over the station.

entries.name: Soldier Pile & Timber Lagging Shoring Wall
entries.variant: HP 10x42 soldier piles at 6 ft O.C., 3x12 treated rough-sawn lagging, hardwood wedges
entries.material: HP 10x42 structural steel piles, 3x12 ACQ treated fir timber lagging, hardwood leveling wedges, 3/8 in steel retainers

tips.frame: Plumb and align steel soldier piles before hand-excavating 3 to 4 ft soil benches between flanges.
general: Tuck lagging boards behind pile flanges with a minimum 2-inch bearing seat on each steel flange.
Drive hardwood wedges tightly behind lagging boards to compress granular backfill and prevent void collapse.

watchOut: Never advance excavation more than one lift below installed lagging to prevent slope sloughing or trench collapse.
Pack straw, filter fabric, or pea gravel behind timber gaps to stop fine soil migration during wet weather.

parts.name: Steel retainer plate lower left pile
Steel retainer plate lower center pile
Steel retainer plate lower right pile
Steel retainer plate upper left pile
Steel retainer plate upper center pile
Steel retainer plate upper right pile

steps.title: Set and plumb HP 10x42 soldier piles
steps.detail: Drive or pre-drill and place the three HP 10x42 steel soldier piles at 1830 mm (6 ft) centers, ensuring all front flanges are aligned and plumb.

steps.title: Tuck lower timber lagging courses
steps.detail: Excavate the lower bench and tuck rough-sawn 3x12 treated lagging courses 1 and 2 behind the front pile flanges in both spans.

steps.title: Stack intermediate timber lagging courses
steps.detail: Progressively excavate down and install lagging courses 3 through 5, seating each board tightly against the course below.

steps.title: Install upper timber lagging courses
steps.detail: Complete lagging up to grade with courses 6 through 8, maintaining full bearing contact across the back of each steel pile flange.

steps.title: Drive hardwood leveling wedges
steps.detail: Drive paired hardwood wedges behind the lagging ends to force the timber tight against the front flange inside faces.

steps.title: Fasten steel retainer plates
steps.detail: Bolt 3/8-inch steel retainer plates across the pile flanges to lock the lagging assembly firmly into place against earth pressure.

entries.name: Solid Surface Countertop: Chemical Seam & Undermount Sink
entries.variant: 1/2 in acrylic sheet, color-matched methacrylate, routed bevel drip edge
entries.material: 1/2 in acrylic solid surface sheet, 2-part methacrylate seam adhesive, clamp blocks, stainless undermount sink, silicone

tips.frame: Mirror-cut mating sheet edges using a plunge router riding against a rigid straightedge to ensure zero gap.
general: Hot-melt clamp blocks to both sheets, dispense two-part colored adhesive generously, and draw joint tight with wooden hand screws.
Route sink cutout with a flush-trim bearing bit, round over edges with a 1/4 in radius bit, and finish with random orbital sanding.

watchOut: Internal cutouts must have rounded corners (minimum 1/2 in radius); 90-degree square inside cuts cause stress fractures.
Do not over-tighten seam clamps; squeezing out all adhesive will result in a dry, weak joint.

parts.name: Solid surface deck with sink cutout
Beveled solid surface seam reinforcement plate
Undermount slotted mounting brackets and inserts

steps.title: Level cabinets and fasten ladder support frame
steps.detail: Set the base cabinets level and anchor the moisture-resistant plywood ladder support perimeter to allow convective airflow under the solid surface.

steps.title: Dry-fit solid surface slabs and prepare joint
steps.detail: Position the left sink slab and right slab onto the frame with mirror-cut joint edges cleaned thoroughly with denatured alcohol.

steps.title: Apply methacrylate adhesive and draw seam tight
steps.detail: Dispense color-matched 2-part methacrylate adhesive along the seam line, secure wood blocks with hot-melt glue, pull the joint tight with parallel clamps, and bond the reinforcement plate beneath.

steps.title: Bond front drop-edge buildup
steps.detail: Adhere the stacked solid surface drop strips along the underside front edge using chemical seam adhesive to provide stock for the routed drip profile.

steps.title: Install undermount sink and mechanical clips
steps.detail: Apply a continuous bead of neutral-cure silicone along the stainless sink rim, seat the flange against the underside of the cutout, and tighten threaded anchor clips into solid surface inserts.

entries.name: Solid Surface Fabricator: Undermount Sink & Field Seam
entries.variant: 1/2 in acrylic solid surface slab, integral undermount bowl, two-part epoxy seam
entries.material: 1/2 in acrylic sheet, acrylic bowl, 2-part methyl methacrylate adhesive, aluminum heat-conductive tape, silicone

tips.frame: Support the undermount sink bowl with a wooden clamp bar and threaded rod through the drain hole during glue cure.
general: Degrease all seam contact edges with denatured alcohol prior to applying color-matched methacrylate adhesive.
Machine the sink rim cutout using a dedicated acrylic template and ball-bearing flush-trim router bit.

watchOut: Never route sharp 90-degree internal corner cutouts; internal corners must have minimum 1/2 in radiused fillets to avoid stress cracks.
Ensure 100% glue squeeze-out along all seam joints to eliminate microscopic bacterial pockets.

parts.name: Right solid surface slab with cutout

steps.title: Set cabinets and ladder frame substrate
steps.detail: Level and anchor base cabinets, then fasten open perimeter plywood ladder rails to permit thermal movement.

steps.title: Bond undermount acrylic sink bowl
steps.detail: Apply two-part methyl methacrylate adhesive to the bowl rim, clamp underneath the slab cutout, and attach the strainer basket.

steps.title: Position seam reinforcement and left slab
steps.detail: Rebate the solid surface seam reinforcement plate across the web frame and set the left countertop slab in place.

steps.title: Draw and cure methyl methacrylate field seam
steps.detail: Inject color-matched two-part acrylic adhesive along the mirror-cut seam edges and tension with clamping blocks until full squeeze-out occurs.

steps.title: Adhere perimeter apron and backsplash
steps.detail: Laminate front build-up fascia strips under the front edge and set backsplashes against the wall with silicone adhesive.

entries.name: Flared Skylight Light Shaft Framing
entries.variant: Double 2x8 roof headers, plumb upper curb, splayed 2x4 angled shaft studs to ceiling grid
entries.material: SPF 2x8 double headers, SPF 2x4 splay studs, Simpson joist hangers, 3 in framing nails

tips.frame: Lay out the wider ceiling opening relative to the roof rough opening to determine the exact bevel angles on splayed studs.
general: Cut compound miters on vertical shaft studs to achieve tight bearing against both roof rafters and ceiling joists.
Install continuous solid backing blocks along all corner transitions for inside drywall joints.

watchOut: Ensure double roof headers and trimmers are supported by properly sized structural joist hangers.
Allow adequate space around the exterior curb perimeter for code-mandated ice-and-water flashing membranes.

steps.title: Frame the ceiling grid opening
steps.detail: Assemble the ceiling trimmers and headers to establish the flared shaft base opening, checking diagonal measurements.

steps.title: Mount roof double trimmers and headers
steps.detail: Nail double 2x8 roof headers into joist hangers secured against the paired roof trimmers.

steps.title: Install plumb roof curb
steps.detail: Fasten 2x6 plumb curb plates squarely above the roof rough opening to receive the skylight unit.

steps.title: Install splayed corner shaft studs
steps.detail: Bevel-cut and toe-nail the four 2x4 splay corner studs from the ceiling framing up to the roof headers.

steps.title: Infill splayed intermediate studs
steps.detail: Set intermediate angled 2x4 studs on each flared face to support drywall backing along the shaft run.

entries.name: Gymnasium Sprung Wood Flooring Sleeper System
entries.variant: 25/32 x 2-1/4 in maple flooring, 2x3 soft pine sleepers with 3/8 in neoprene pads (12 in O.C.), steel drive pins
entries.material: MFMA maple T&G strips, 2x3 resilient cushioned sleepers, conical neoprene pads, 2 in barbed cleats, 6-mil poly barrier

tips.frame: Snap layout lines 12 inches on center across vapor-barrier covered concrete for sleeper placement.
general: Anchor sleepers with steel drive pins through predrilled oval slots that permit vertical deflection flex.
Blind-nail tongue-and-groove maple strips at 45-degree angles using a pneumatic flooring nailer.

watchOut: Maintain a 1.5 to 2-inch expansion void around all walls and columns concealed by vented base cove molding.
Do not tightly cram maple strips in humid weather; use spacer washers to preserve designed seasonal expansion gaps.

steps.title: Lay vapor barrier over slab
steps.detail: Inspect the concrete slab for flatness within 1/8 in over 10 ft, then roll out 6-mil polyethylene barrier with 6 in lap seams taped securely.

steps.title: Set cushioned resilient sleepers
steps.detail: Place 2x3 soft pine sleepers with factory-attached 3/8 in conical neoprene pads at 12 in on center, securing to concrete with steel drive pins.

steps.title: Fasten perimeter wall backing
steps.detail: Anchor the wood perimeter backing plate to establish a strict 2 in expansion perimeter void for climate-induced wood movement.

steps.title: Lay and blind-nail starter maple field
steps.detail: Square and anchor the 25/32 x 2-1/4 in MFMA northern hard maple strips perpendicular to the sleepers, maintaining perimeter relief gaps.

steps.title: Engage tongue-and-groove courses with barbed cleats
steps.detail: Stagger end-joints at least 6 in between adjacent courses and drive 2 in barbed steel cleats at 45 degrees through strip tongues into every sleeper.

steps.title: Install vented perimeter cove molding
steps.detail: Fasten heavy-duty vented cove base to the wall plate, spanning the 2 in expansion void to circulate subfloor air and prevent moisture accumulation.

entries.name: Freestanding Stair Landing Platform
entries.variant: 2x8 perimeter frame and joists at 16 in O.C., 4x4 corner posts, 3/4 in T&G subfloor
entries.material: SPF 2x8 joists, 4x4 posts, 3/4 in tongue-and-groove plywood, Simpson joist hangers, 1/2 in carriage bolts

tips.frame: Establish the top-of-subfloor landing height so that rising and descending stair risers remain uniform within 3/8 in.
general: Square the landing frame by cross-measuring diagonals before locking post-to-beam bolted connections.
Apply subfloor adhesive to all joist tops before fastening sheathing with 2-1/2 in ring-shank nails.

watchOut: Ensure posts rest on solid floor framing or footings below, never directly on unsupported subfloor spans.
Tighten all structural bolts with torque washers to avoid crushing soft wood fibers over time.

steps.title: Position and plumb the four corner posts
steps.detail: Set the four 4x4 posts vertically on a level slab spaced to the 1200 mm perimeter marks. Check each column with a spirit level in two axes.

steps.title: Bolt side rim joists to corner posts
steps.detail: Clamp the left and right 2x8 rim joists flush with post tops and drill 1/2 in clearance holes. Secure two carriage bolts per post and torque down washers and hex nuts.

steps.title: Fasten front and back header joists
steps.detail: Align front and back 2x8 headers between the rim boards tight against the post faces. Fasten end grain with structural framing screws and secure to the inner post faces.

steps.title: Mount joist hangers and seat intermediate joists
steps.detail: Layout intermediate joists at 16 inch centers along the headers. Fasten Simpson joist hangers using 10d hanger nails, then seat joists flush to top edge.

steps.title: Fasten tongue-and-groove subfloor panel
steps.detail: Apply construction adhesive along top joist edges and drop the 3/4 inch plywood decking squarely over the frame. Drive subfloor screws every 6 inches along perimeter and 12 inches in the field.

entries.name: Structural Steel: HSS Column Base Plate & Non-Shrink Grout Bed
entries.variant: HSS 6x6x3/8 column, 14x14x1 in base plate, 4-bolt anchor template, leveling nuts, and non-shrink precision grout
entries.material: HSS 6x6 steel tube, 1 in A36 base plate, 3/4 in F1554 anchor rods, leveling nuts, dry-pack non-shrink grout

tips.frame: Establish finished base plate elevation using four leveling nuts set precisely to benchmark with an optical level.
general: Maintain a 1 to 1-1/2 in standoff between the concrete pedestal top and the underside of the base plate for grout flow.
Tamp stiff non-shrink grout solidly with a hardwood packing wedge to eliminate air pockets beneath the base plate.

watchOut: Never remove leveling nuts or load the column until grout reaches designated compressive cure strength.
Anchor bolts out of plumb will bind in standard 5/16 in oversized base plate holes.

steps.title: Cast foundation pedestal with embedded anchor rods
steps.desc: Position the four-rod anchor template and cast the reinforced concrete pedestal, leaving 120 mm rod projection above rough slab.

steps.title: Set leveling nuts and washers to benchmark elevation
steps.desc: Thread heavy hex leveling nuts and hardened washers onto each anchor rod, adjusting all four to exact benchmark elevation with a machinist level.

steps.title: Land HSS column assembly onto leveling nuts
steps.desc: Lower the HSS column and welded base plate assembly over the anchor pattern until resting solidly on all four leveling washers.

steps.title: Install upper washers and secure anchor nuts
steps.desc: Place top washers and thread heavy hex nuts onto the anchor rods, snug-tightening with a spud wrench while verifying column plumb.

steps.title: Pack non-shrink precision grout under base plate
steps.desc: Tightly dry-pack high-strength non-shrink precision grout into the 50 mm bed below the plate, ensuring full bearing contact with no voids.

entries.name: Steel Moment Frame WUF-B Connection: Welded Flange, Bolted Web
entries.variant: W14x90 column, W18x50 girder, 1/2 in shear tab, A325 bolts, and CJP groove welds
entries.material: ASTM A992 structural steel wide-flange beams, A36 shear tab, 7/8 in A325 bolts, E7018 electrodes, ceramic weld backing

tips.frame: Plumb and snug-bolt the girder shear tab to establish root opening before installing weld run-off tabs.
general: Bevel girder top and bottom flanges to a 45-degree angle with a 1/4 in root opening against column face.
Execute complete joint penetration (CJP) multi-pass welds using preheat according to AWS D1.1 specifications.

watchOut: Never torque web bolts to final tension until flange CJP welds have completely cooled to ambient temperature.
Failing to grind out backing bars and add reinforcement fillets where seismic detailing applies will fail ultrasonic testing.

steps.title: Set Base Plate and Erect Column
steps.detail: Anchor the 30 mm base plate to foundation studs, plumb the W14x90 column vertical, and weld column base perimeter.

steps.title: Fit Column Continuity Plates
steps.detail: Fit four 16 mm stiffener continuity plates between column flanges aligned with the anticipated girder flange elevations.

steps.title: Weld Shear Tab to Column Flange
steps.detail: Position the 1/2 in shear tab on the column strong-axis flange centerline and deposit double fillet shop welds.

steps.title: Hang Girder and Snug Web Bolts
steps.detail: Hoist the W18x50 girder into position against the shear tab, align standard holes, and torque 7/8 in A325 bolts to snug tight.

steps.title: Install Ceramic Weld Backing
steps.detail: Attach ceramic backing strips under the top and bottom girder flange bevel joints across the full flange width.

steps.title: Deposit CJP Flange Groove Welds
steps.detail: Deposit multi-pass complete joint penetration groove welds using E7018 electrodes through the prepared weld access holes.

entries.name: Freestanding Half-Wall (Pony Wall) Framing
entries.variant: 2x4 studs at 16 in O.C., double top plate, through-bolted bottom plate, 4x4 end stiffener post
entries.material: SPF 2x4 studs and plates, 4x4 structural post, 1/2 in threaded rod or Simpson HDU hold-down, 3 in framing nails

tips.frame: Locate floor joists beneath the partition to run continuous threaded tie-down rods directly through the subfloor.
general: Lock the unsupported terminal end with an engineered 4x4 post anchored to floor framing with a steel hold-down bracket.
Install solid horizontal blocking at mid-height to enhance torsional resistance against sideways leaning.

watchOut: Standard face-nailing to subfloor will result in a wobbly half-wall; positive mechanical tie-downs are mandatory.
Ensure bottom plate anchors do not puncture radiant heating tubes embedded in the floor substrate.

steps.title: Set and anchor the sole plate
steps.detail: Lay out the 2x4 sole plate on chalk line. Drill and fasten through-floor anchor bolts with plate washers.

steps.title: Anchor the 4x4 terminal stiffener post
steps.detail: Plumb the 4x4 end post at the freestanding termination and anchor the Simpson HDU hold-down to transfer cantilever overturning moments.

steps.title: Frame intermediate 2x4 studs
steps.detail: Nail intermediate 2x4 wall studs spaced 16 in on-centre to the bottom plate using three 16d toenails per stud base.

steps.title: Install anti-rotation mid-height blocking
steps.detail: Install tight-fitting 2x4 solid horizontal blocking centered at mid-height across all bays to eliminate stud rotation and racking.

steps.title: Fasten double top plate
steps.detail: Cap the studs and post with the lower top plate and fasten the upper top plate with staggered 16d nails every 16 inches.

entries.name: Storm Catch Basin Top Slab, Riser & Grate
entries.variant: 24x24 in precast catch basin, mortar leveling bed, bicycle-safe cast-iron frame and curb hood
entries.material: Precast reinforced concrete riser ring, class 30B cast iron frame and vane grate, non-shrink masonry setting mortar, butyl sealant

tips.frame: Set precast grade adjustment ring over the basin top slab with flexible butyl gasket between concrete joints.
general: Trowel a stiff 1-1/2 inch non-shrink mortar bed across the concrete ring to receive the heavy cast-iron casting.
Set frame flush to 1/4 inch below finished asphalt binder course, matching street cross-slope and curb flow line.

watchOut: Use mechanical hoist or two-person lift team when seating the heavy cast-iron frame to prevent crushed finger hazards.
Check vane direction on the grate: directional bars must angle downstream toward curb inlet to prevent bicycle tire trap accidents.

steps.title: Set the precast concrete riser
steps.detail: Lower the 24x24-inch precast riser section into the trench, checking square and planar level across both axes.

steps.title: Apply butyl mastic sealant rope
steps.detail: Lay continuous strands of flexible butyl sealant along the top lip of the riser walls to ensure a watertight joint.

steps.title: Set the grade adjustment top slab
steps.detail: Center the precast transition slab onto the compressed butyl gasket, confirming plumb alignment with the riser throat.

steps.title: Strike non-shrink mortar leveling bed
steps.detail: Spread a stiff 25 mm thick ring of non-shrink setting mortar over the concrete slab to bring the frame to finished roadway grade.

steps.title: Bed frame and bolt curb hood
steps.detail: Embed the cast-iron frame solidly into the mortar bed, tap to road crown slope, and fasten the curb inlet hood to the rear flange.

steps.title: Seat bicycle-safe vane grate
steps.detail: Lower the cast-iron vane grate flush into the machined frame seat, orienting diagonal vanes perpendicular to curb flow.

entries.name: Structural Steel Chevron Braced Frame Connection
entries.variant: HSS 6x6 columns, W10x33 beam, 3/8 in gusset plate, paired HSS 4x4 braces
entries.material: HSS 6x6x3/8 columns, W10x33 wide flange beam, HSS 4x4x1/4 diagonal braces, 3/8 in A36 gusset, 3/4 in A325 bolts

tips.frame: Strike working point chalklines through the intersection of the beam centerline and column centerlines to position the gusset.
general: Clamp diagonal tube braces firmly to gusset tabs before reaming or driving erection drift pins.
Ensure weld access clearance is maintained around beam web stiffeners and gusset bevels.

watchOut: Never burn oversized slotted holes with a torch without structural engineer approval.
Beware of pinch hazards when drifting bolt holes under suspended steel members.

steps.title: Set base plates and erect HSS columns
steps.detail: Anchor the 300x300 mm base plates to the foundation and plumb both HSS 6x6 columns using transit levels before torquing anchor nuts.

steps.title: Fit beam shear tabs and erect W10x33 beam
steps.detail: Weld shear connection tabs to the inside column faces, fly in the W10x33 beam with crane rigging, and pin with 3/4-inch A325 high-strength bolts.

steps.title: Weld apex gusset and web stiffeners
steps.detail: Fit the transverse web stiffeners inside the beam profile and complete full-penetration groove welds attaching the 3/8-inch chevron gusset to the beam bottom flange.

steps.title: Install column base gussets
